title: Senior Technical Architect & Developer – Marketing Automation
description_clean:
Who is Sonar?
Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. 
Position Description
We are seeking a deeply technical Marketing Technology Architect / Developer to lead the data architecture, custom code development, system integrations, and infrastructure scalability of our marketing engine.
Our day-to-day stack currently relies on Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) as our primary engine, and we are actively considering next-generation architecture like Marketing Cloud Next. However, for us, specific tool proficiency takes a backseat to a genuine passion for marketing technology, AI-driven marketing innovations, robust data architecture, and technical problem-solving.
We value your ability to analyze complex data models, integrate APIs, write clean code, and optimize high-throughput automation pipelines over specific certifications. If you are a platform-agnostic technologist passionate about marketing tech stack mechanics and AI marketing tools, this role provides the scope and autonomy to build world-class system infrastructure.
What you will doData Architecture & Engineering


Operations Enablement: Prepare, clean, structure, and model marketing data for Marketing Operations teams to run campaigns, segment audiences, and manage daily operations friction-free.


Data Modeling: Build and optimize scalable relational database structures, data extensions, custom models, and subscriber key lifecycles for operational needs.


ETL & Data Pipelines: Partner with the Data Team to create automated SQL queries and ETL pipelines ingesting and transforming data warehouse datasets (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery) into production-ready data extensions.


Governance & Hygiene: Maintain data hygiene, identity resolution, deduplication, and real-time ecosystem syncs to ensure efficiency.


 
Technical Customization & Custom Development


Write maintainable custom platform code (e.g., AMPscript, SSJS, WSProxy) for personalization engines.


Develop dynamic rendering logic, interactive web forms, and secure landing pages.


Troubleshoot automation failures, script exceptions, and data bottlenecks.


 
API & Ecosystem Integrations


Architect and maintain API integrations (REST, SOAP, Webhooks) connecting product apps, mobile backends, and third-party systems to the marketing platform.


Configure native CRM and database connectors for low-latency, real-time bidirectional sync.


Manage rate limits, payload efficiency, OAuth, and retry handlers.


 
Platform Operations & System Health


Monitor runtimes, script performance, and query execution to ensure 99.9% uptime.


Lead security governance, permissions, business unit structuring, and privacy compliance (GDPR, CCPA, CAN-SPAM).


Partner with DevOps and IT Security on domain authentication and deliverability infrastructure.

Experience and qualificationsCore Technical Competencies


Advanced SQL & Database Design: Extensive experience with relational data modeling, complex joins, aggregation, and query tuning.


Integrations & Protocols: Strong knowledge of REST/SOAP APIs, JSON/XML, OAuth 2.0, webhooks, and Postman.


Scripting & Code: Skilled in AMPscript, SSJS, or general languages (JavaScript, Node.js, Python) applied to MarTech.


MarTech & AI Curiosity: Passionate about marketing architecture, event triggers, relational mapping, agentic AI, CDPs, and automated personalization.


 
Experience


3+ years in technical architecture, administration, or development in Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) (Automation Studio, Journey Builder, Contact Builder, CloudPages, APIs, or Data Cloud/AI frameworks).


Practical understanding of how Predictive, Generative, and Agentic AI transform technical marketing.




Proven track record of evaluating and mastering new marketing platforms and technical tools.


 
Key Personality Traits


Tech & AI Enthusiast: Actively follows MarTech, CDPs, AI automation, and data engineering trends.


Platform Agnostic: Uses tools and AI models adaptively to solve data and communication challenges.


Problem Solver: Enjoys debugging complex data issues, race conditions, integrations, and AI logic edge cases.


In-office culture
We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having. 
Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted  — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.
 
We value diversity, equity, and inclusion
At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. About the Run & Grow:
Run & Grow is where SumUp builds the platforms and capabilities that help merchants discover, join, use, and continue growing with our products. The tribe brings together engineering, product, design, and revenue operations teams around two connected goals: helping SumUp serve and retain merchants, and accelerating acquisition, activation, and engagement.
Our work sits at the heart of SumUp's growth engine. We turn complex challenges across merchant acquisition, identity, marketing technology, commercial systems, operations, risk, and compliance into reliable products and services that other teams can build on. The systems we create help SumUp move faster, make better decisions, and deliver a simpler experience to millions of small businesses.
Joining Run & Grow means working on high-impact engineering problems with a broad view of the business. You'll collaborate across disciplines and teams, shape the foundations behind important merchant journeys, and help create a more connected, scalable way for SumUp to run and grow.
 
What you'll do:

Design, build, and operate production-grade backend services, APIs, and integrations, primarily using Go.
Build event-driven workflows and distributed systems using technologies such as Kafka and asynchronous processing.
Define clear service boundaries, data models, schemas, and API contracts that other teams can use confidently.
Build capabilities supporting merchant acquisition, identity, marketing technology, operations, risk, and compliance.
Own technical work end to end, from discovery and system design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production follow-up.
Modernise existing services and improve reliability through observability, security, failure handling, and incident response.
Collaborate with Product, Data, Operations, Compliance, Risk, Sales, Marketing, and other engineering teams to turn complex requirements into practical solutions.
Review code and designs, make pragmatic technical trade-offs, share knowledge, and mentor engineers around you

 
You'll be great for this role if you:

Bring a strong backend engineering background in Go, or are a typed-language generalist ready to ramp up quickly
Have designed APIs and distributed systems with clear contracts, versioning, and integration patterns
Are fluent in relational and analytical databases (PostgreSQL, Snowflake) and comfortable making the right choice for the right use case
Have built Kafka-based, event-driven systems and understand event sourcing and CDC patterns
Have experience in auditable, high-trust systems where every decision must be traceable fintech, payments, or similar domains
Have experience with testing, observability, and incident response practices and treat them as first-class concerns, not afterthoughts
Take ownership of ambiguous problems and turn them into clear, scalable, and maintainable solutions.
Communicate clearly, collaborate effectively, and explain technical concepts and trade-offs to different audiences.
Value pragmatic engineering, continuous improvement, mentoring, and reliable production operations.

description_clean:
About Wolt
At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.About the Team
Cx App Foundations is a platform organisation within our global Cx organisation. It provides shared consumer foundations and platform capabilities used by engineering teams across Wolt, DoorDash, and Deliveroo. Within this organisation, the Velocity team owns the paved road for consumer app development across mobile and web: shared SDKs and client foundations, integration patterns and multi-brand customisation, migration playbooks and reference implementations, and developer tooling that makes building on shared foundations fast and safe. Our mission is to reduce the cost, time, and risk of building consumer experiences across platforms and brands. Product teams own customer-facing experiences; our job is to make sure they can spend their time on delivering delightful experiences. The team is AI-native: AI is a default part of how we design, build, and ship software.
About the Role
As the Engineering Manager, you will lead a team of experienced engineers across mobile and web, collaborating closely with product teams, design, and adjacent platform organisations across three brands. Your primary responsibility will be owning the team's roadmap and delivery of shared client foundations, and driving their adoption across the organisation, so that product teams ship delightful customer experiences without rebuilding the foundations under them. You will be a key player in keeping the team's operating model healthy: clear intake from stakeholders, predictable delivery, and support expectations that keep the platform from drifting into a general escalation queue. You will also guide architectural and system design decisions with your tech leads. You will stay hands-on: contributing code, reviews, and prototypes alongside the team is part of the job. This role is ideal for a leader who has run platforms, SDKs, or shared services for other engineering teams, communicates clearly across brands and time zones, and wants their impact measured through what other teams achieve with the foundations you ship.
You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

Own the platform roadmap - the shared SDKs, client foundations, and developer tooling the team ships - and sequence it against the migration and adoption goals of the three brands
Drive adoption of the shared foundations by partnering with product teams, running onboarding and rollout support, and making the supported path the easiest path
Lead, coach, and grow experienced mobile and web engineers, keeping growth conversations, calibration, and feedback loops running
Keep the team's operating model healthy: clear intake (stakeholder management, shared-platform, product-specific, or exception work), supported capabilities with entry criteria and support expectations, and predictable delivery
Guide architectural and system design decisions for client foundations that three brands and multiple app platforms depend on
Stay hands-on by contributing code and reviews alongside the team, and champion AI-native development practices
Grow the team through hiring

 
Our humble expectations

You have 3+ years of experience managing engineers, including a team with senior engineers
You have a solid background (5+ years) in mobile or web engineering, with enough technical depth to hold your own in architecture discussions about client foundations
You use AI tooling fluently in your day-to-day work and stay close to the code
You have run a platform, SDK, or shared service that other teams depend on, and know how to treat internal customers as customers
You work across boundaries naturally: product teams, design, other platform organisations, data/analytics and stakeholders in other locations and time zones
You hold a high bar for engineering quality and can navigate production incidents and release tradeoffs with calm structure

What we offer
A platform leadership role with real leverage: the foundations the team owns shape how consumer experiences get built across Wolt, DoorDash, and Deliveroo, and your roadmap decisions multiply across every product team that builds on them.
Next steps
The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!
The compensation will be a combination of monthly pay and DoorDash RSUs. The latter makes it exceptionally easy to be excited about our company growing and doing well, as you'll own a piece of the pie.
 
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

description_clean: About CodatCodat is an advisory intelligence solution purpose-built for modern commercial banking. Through rich, specialized data, forward-looking insights, and integrated workflows, Codat empowers banking teams to deepen their relationships, grow their revenue, and simplify their day-to-day work.Founded in 2017 and backed by JPMorgan, PayPal, Amex, Plaid, and Shopify, Codat has successfully powered over 350,000 connections to business customers’ financial systems — and is trusted by industry leaders to turn scattered information into actionable, strategic advantages in real time, every time.The RoleWe're building the Advisory Intelligence Platform: Codat's client intelligence delivered inside the assistant a banker already uses (Microsoft Copilot first). Ask it anything about a client and it answers from the client's real books. Don't ask, and it still tells you what's changed, why it matters and what to do about it. Under it we're building the semantic layer, so every answer uses the same definitions, the signal layer that spots what's changed for a client, and the reasoning layer, a Codat-side LLM that turns those signals into advice. The first bank goes live this year. You'll be building the data and reasoning behind all of it.This is a hands-on job for software engineers who want to build the systems a model reasons over, not configure a warehouse. Codat is AI-first, not AI bolted onto SaaS. The product lives inside the AI assistant our clients already use, and we build it the same way: agents do the repetitive work, engineers do the hard parts. You'll build it and you'll run it. Nobody hands it over the wall once it's live. You'll also get a real say in where it goes next. That means making your case to engineers, product and the commercial team, and bringing them along with you.What You'll Work OnThe semantic layer. Measures, dimensions and definitions the model is allowed to use, so every answer it gives is the same answer. Yours to grow, persona by persona.The signal layer. Detecting what's changed for a client and surfacing it before the banker asks. You'll be designing and building this.The reasoning layer. A Codat-side LLM that turns signals into advice. Our calculations are the ground truth it reasons over. You own the calculations the model relies on, and the names, definitions and structure that let it pick the right one.The agents and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers behind the assistant. What tools it has, how they're built, how they fail, and the evals that prove they work.Everything from raw source data to the number the assistant quotes: the pipelines, services and data models, with the testing and observability to prove the number is right and the evals that catch the model quoting the wrong one.You'll Probably HaveBuilt production systems from scratch, writing the code yourself rather than configuring managed services. You think about interfaces, failure modes and how the next person will change your code. If we ask about the hardest system you've built, you'll have a story ready.Served data to an LLM and seen where it goes wrong: ambiguous definitions, poor retrieval, no evals. You know why "the model will work it out" isn't a data strategy.Worked with data along the way, and liked it. You may never have been called a data engineer. You've built things that move, shape and serve data, and you know how they break, and how a model breaks on top of them.Solid C#, Python or another backend language. Your code comes with tests, and you leave things tidier than you found them.Depth in at least one of SQL, Spark, Databricks/Delta Lake, Dagster/Airflow/Temporal or dbt. Bonus if you've shaped any of them into something a model can query, through a metrics layer, metric views or an MCP server.Time with CI/CD, Docker, cloud infrastructure (we're on Azure) and observability. Even better if you set them up for a team.An interest in the business behind the data. If someone asks for a number the data can't support, you'll say so, and you'll build the guard-rail so the model says so too.Treated your own workflow as something to engineer. AI has already taken over the repetitive parts of it, and you're the person others ask how to do the same.How We WorkWe're a small team with plenty to do. Things move fast: we'd rather ship something useful and improve it than polish it in private. What you build is yours from start to finish.There’s no return-to-office mandate, and you can work hybrid or fully remote. We trust you to be around when the team needs you and to deliver what you said you would. What we don’t want is anyone staying online late to prove a point.Compensation: £90K – £110K • Offers Equity • £90K – £110K • Offers EquityFind Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Who We Are
At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.
Why Join Us
We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.The Role 
We are looking for a Senior Infrastructure Manager who is, first and foremost, a people leader.
In this role, your primary responsibility is the health, performance, and career growth of your engineering team. While you must possess a solid technical background to understand the challenges your team faces, your day-to-day focus will not be hands-on technical work. Instead, you will use your experience to remove blockers, guide decision-making, and ensure your engineers have the environment they need to succeed.
 
The Team You Will Lead 
You will lead the Infrastructure Solutions team within the wider Technical Operations department. Your engineers are responsible for building the environment, delivering projects as requested by Engineering and Product, and ensuring we remain available, scalable, and secure. They are not responsible for the BAU function of the platforms that is managed by another team within Technical Operations. The Infrastructure Solutions team takes a concept or idea and makes that into a reality within the boundaries and constraints of our platforms. 
You will be managing a team of engineers who individually possess experience in:

On-Premise Linux systems, Container solutions, Debian packaging, Ansible, data streaming and queuing technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ
Advanced database management knowledge (MySQL, Postgres) in replicated environments.
Physical Network management, with an on-prem estate that is Juniper focused. 
Cloud environments: GCP and AWS
Platform engineer focused on building, maintaining and supporting an Internal Developer Platform (CI/CD)

 
The Operational Reality
It is important to be transparent about the environment you are joining. We operate at high velocity with a broad and complex technology estate. However, we are a lean team, not a giant corporation with endless resources.

Context Switching is the Norm

You will rarely have the luxury of focusing on a single task for weeks at a time. You will be required to shift focus multiple times a week, and sometimes multiple times a day, as business priorities evolve.

Agility over Silos

Because we are a lean team, we wear many hats. You must be comfortable pivoting from a strategic discussion to an operational challenge without losing momentum.

Focus Management

Success in this role requires the ability to maintain high standards while navigating a workload that changes dynamically. This is not a role for those who prefer a slow, singular focus; it is for those who thrive on variety, pace, and solving complex problems in real-time.


 
As the Senior Infrastructure Manager, You Will:
People Leadership & Talent Development

Team Management

Lead, mentor, and motivate a team of infrastructure engineers. Conduct weekly 1-2-1s, manage performance reviews, and handle all aspects of people management.

Formal Training & Growth

Go beyond ad-hoc mentoring to schedule and lead formal training sessions regarding operational improvements. Actively create professional development plans for your direct reports.

Recruitment & Retention

Own the hiring process for your team, ensuring we attract top talent and maintain a supportive, inclusive culture.

Culture of Learning

Foster a "Self-Learner" mindset. Create a transparent environment where failures are treated as learning opportunities and documented as such for future reference.


Strategic & Operational Management

Budget & Capacity Planning

Ability to own your team's budget and lead capacity planning initiatives. You will forecast future infrastructure needs to ensure we remain scalable while managing spend for subscriptions and hardware.

Risk & Contingency

Proactively identify operational risks and form contingency plans immediately to ensure business continuity.

Procedure & Frameworks

Ability to define, maintain, and cascade operational procedures (SOPs) and ITIL standards.

Prioritisation

Shield your team from noise by effectively prioritising workloads (Changes, Problems, and Projects) and managing stakeholder expectations.


Technical Support & Oversight

Performance Optimisation

Measure and optimise system performance with a focus on improving reliability and time-to-market. You will drive innovation to get ahead of internal customer needs rather than just reacting to them.

Visual Documentation

Ensure the team produces detailed system design documentation, specifically enforcing the inclusion of visual representations to support understanding. Ability to technologically assess it as a technical editor.

Hybrid Estate Management

Ability to oversee the management of both On-Premise and Cloud (GCP/AWS), ensuring high availability across all environments.

Unblocking Issues

Act as the senior escalation point for complex technical issues. Your goal is not to fix the issue yourself, but to coordinate the right resources and provide air cover.


General Duties
On-Call DutiesWillingness to participate in the Management On-Call Rotation to support the department and the business (Current frequency: Once every three weeks). Ad-HocCarry out other strategic or technical duties required to support the Director/VP of Technical Operations.
Essential Knowledge, Skills, and Experience
Leadership & Management Competencies

Proven Management Experience

Significant experience leading a technical team, with a specific focus on the people management aspect (performance reviews, career growth etc).

Project Management

Strong project management experience with the ability to delegate effectively to meet tight deadlines. You must be able to multitask and maintain focus in a high-priority environment.

Communication

Exceptional verbal and written communication skills. You must be able to liaise effectively with management and other business areas. Engagement may also include interactions with senior technical engineers/leaders within other teams and C-Team members. 

Goal Oriented

You must be highly goal-oriented with strict attention to detail, capable of prioritising workload and demand to ensure targets are met.

ITIL Application / Lean Six Sigma

Deep knowledge of and experience with ITIL practices, with the ability to apply them to improve team workflows. Demonstrated ability to apply Lean Six Sigma concepts.


 
Technical Environment & Team Capabilities
Focusing on the technical skills that your engineers possess, it would be ideal if you had a decent working knowledge of each of the areas. Hands-on expertise in every area is not required, but the ability to hold and facilitate discussions, know when to push or hold back and when to ask poignant questions will help you effectively mentor the team and guide architectural decisions. 
For reference from above these areas are: on-prem and AWS/GCP solutions; system design from network to application level; resilient database availability strategies; automation and configuration management via Ansible, Docker and CI/CD; programming awareness in Python; Linux administration.
Your willingness to learn what you don't know is required to succeed in this role and we will support you through that journey.
 
Desirable Knowledge, Skills, and Experience
The following skills or experiences are advantageous but not strictly required. They would be utilised for facilitating tasks rather than for direct, hands-on implementation.

Innovation & Debt Management

A keen interest in new technologies and innovation, specifically supporting development teams in the refactoring of technical debt.

Advanced Containerization

Deep knowledge of Kubernetes, Docker, and container ecosystems.

Observability

Experience with monitoring systems (e.g., Zabbix, Grafana) and logging stacks (Elasticsearch, Kibana).

Data Streaming

Experience with data streaming and queuing technologies, specifically Apache Kafka and Druid.

Web & Storage

Knowledge of Nginx (or other web server technologies) and storage technologies like Gluster.

Tooling

Proficiency with JIRA and Confluence for project tracking and documentation.

Version Control

strong understanding of Git and version control best practices.


 
Why This Role?
If you are an experienced technical leader who finds more satisfaction in growing people and building high-performing teams than in closing tickets yourself, this is the role for you. You will have the autonomy to shape the culture of the Infrastructure function and the strategic backing to make a real impact on the business
 
This role operates on a hybrid basis and requires attendance in our Newcastle office once a week. While some flexibility may be discussed, applicants should be willing and able to work from the office as part of the role.
 
UK Benefits & Perks

25 days holiday in addition to bank holidays 
Enhanced Parental Leave: 6 months full pay for birth parent, 4 weeks non-birth parent at full pay after one year employment
5 extra 'Partnerize Parental Days' each year
Private Medical Insurance through Vitality 
Enhanced pension contributions
Cycle to Work scheme 
Eye Care Vouchers 
Life Assurance
Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Fridays program
Regular company events and activities
Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion
We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization's success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception.

On-Premise Linux systems, Container solutions, Debian packaging, Ansible, data streaming and queuing technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ
Advanced database management knowledge (MySQL, Postgres) in replicated environments.
Physical Network management, with an on-prem estate that is Juniper focused. 
Cloud environments: GCP and AWS
Platform engineer focused on building, maintaining and supporting an Internal Developer Platform (CI/CD)

It is important to be transparent about the environment you are joining. We operate at high velocity with a broad and complex technology estate. However, we are a lean team, not a giant corporation with endless resources.

Agility over Silos

Because we are a lean team, we wear many hats. You must be comfortable pivoting from a strategic discussion to an operational challenge without losing momentum.

Focus Management

Team Management

Recruitment & Retention

Culture of Learning

Foster a "Self-Learner" mindset. Create a transparent environment where failures are treated as learning opportunities and documented as such for future reference.

Budget & Capacity Planning

Ability to own your team's budget and lead capacity planning initiatives. You will forecast future infrastructure needs to ensure we remain scalable while managing spend for subscriptions and hardware.

Proactively identify operational risks and form contingency plans immediately to ensure business continuity.

Procedure & Frameworks

Ability to define, maintain, and cascade operational procedures (SOPs) and ITIL standards.

Prioritisation

Performance Optimisation

Visual Documentation

Ensure the team produces detailed system design documentation, specifically enforcing the inclusion of visual representations to support understanding. Ability to technologically assess it as a technical editor.

Ability to oversee the management of both On-Premise and Cloud (GCP/AWS), ensuring high availability across all environments.

description_clean:

Loft’s Onboard Software group provides the on-orbit software that powers our satellite fleet — from the Linux services running on the hub processor, to the containerized workloads executing customer applications in low Earth orbit.
The Deployment & Runtime Environments team is where software meets the satellite. description_clean: Présentation de l’Ecole et du laboratoireCréée en 1857, l’École Centrale de Lyon figure parmi le top 10 des écoles d'ingénieurs en France. Elle forme plus de 3 000 élèves de 50 nationalités différentes sur ses campus d'Écully et de Saint-Étienne (ENISE, école interne) : ingénieurs généralistes, ingénieurs de spécialités, masters et doctorants. Avec le Groupe des Écoles Centrale, elle dispose de 3 implantations à l’international. La formation dispensée bénéficie de l’excellence de la recherche des 6 laboratoires labellisés CNRS présents sur ses campus, des 2 laboratoires à l’international, des 6 réseaux de recherche internationaux et des 10 laboratoires communs avec des entreprises. Sa recherche d’excellence et son enseignement de très haut niveau lui permettent de nouer des accords de doubles diplômes avec des universités prestigieuses et des partenariats de pointe avec de nombreuses entreprises. Autour des thématiques de sobriété, d’énergie, d’environnement et de décarbonation, Centrale Lyon entend répondre aux problématiques des acteurs socio-économiques sur les grandes transitions.Ce projet de recherche sera mené au sein du Laboratoire LIRIS (UMR 5205), et en particulier de l’équipe Imagine dont les travaux visent notamment à développer de nouveaux modèles d’apprentissage et de vision pour l’analyse et la compréhension de données visuelles telles que les images et vidéos.Présentation de la thématique :Cette mission s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet Therm_I_Bat associant le LIRIS à l’entreprise CMDL Manaslut Ing. et dont l’objectif est de proposer de nouvelles méthodes d’IA et de Vision par Ordinateurs pour la détection automatique de défauts thermiques dans des prises de vues intérieures de façades pour l’aide au diagnostic de qualité des bâtiments.Description de la missionLa performance énergétique réelle des bâtiments neufs ou rénovés reste souvent en deçà des performances visées en conception, créant un « energy gap » qui freine la décarbonation du secteur. CMDL a développé une solution robotisée capable de réaliser des campagnes de mesures exhaustives (thermographie infrarouge et images RGB) sur des plateaux de bureaux, logements ou usines d’environ 5 000 m² en une nuit. Cependant, aujourd’hui, le traitement est opéré par un expert sur un nombre restreint de fichiers. La multiplication du nombre de fichiers ne permet pas d’imaginer la mobilisation de l’expert, et seul un traitement automatisé sur la base d’un apprentissage du type Intelligence Artificielle est envisageable.Le projet THERM_I_BAT vise à concevoir et valider une preuve de concept de diagnostic intelligent des façades de bâtiments, à partir de prises de vues intérieures réalisées par une plateforme robotisée.Scientifiquement, le projet s’inscrit dans les travaux de recherche et R&D sur l’analyse d’images multimodales et l’apprentissage frugal, en développant de nouveaux modèles d’IA capables de fonctionner avec des jeux de données limités mais fortement contextualisés. Industriellement, il prépare une solution de diagnostic automatisé de la qualité d’enveloppe, compatible avec les outils de la filière (BIM, jumeau numérique) et économiquement acceptable pour un déploiement massif à la réception des bâtiments.Le planning envisagé est le suivant :Phase 1 – Acquisition et préparation des données (M1–M12)•      Définition des protocoles de mesure avec CMDL (typologies de bâtiments, scénarios de défauts).•      Réalisation de campagnes de mesures robotisées (IR + RGB) sur plusieurs sites pilotes.•      Constitution d’un jeu de données annoté (défauts, zones saines, contexte BIM).Phase 2 – Contextualisation spatiale et fusion multimodale (M3–M5)•      Alignement spatial des images IR et RGB, prise en compte de la géométrie des façades.•      Développement de méthodes de fusion multimodale pour produire des représentations conjointes robustes.Phase 3 – Segmentation sémantique et filtrage des perturbations (M6–M9)•      Développement de modèles de segmentation sémantique pour distinguer les zones pertinentes (parois, menuiseries, éléments techniques) des perturbations (mobilier, objets, reflets).•      Intégration de connaissances expertes CMDL pour guider les classes et les règles de filtrage.Phase 4 – Détection d’anomalies et classification des défauts (M10–M16)•      Mise en place de modèles de détection d’anomalies thermiques et de classification des défauts (ponts thermiques, défauts d’étanchéité à l’air, artefacts liés aux matériaux).•      Apprentissage frugal à partir de jeux de données limités, complétés éventuellement par des données simulées.Phase 5 – Génération du diagnostic et validation en environnement pertinent (M16–M18)•      Génération automatique de diagnostics structurés (liste de défauts, typologie, sévérité) et localisation dans le plan/BIM.•      Campagnes de validation sur de nouveaux bâtiments, comparaison avec l’analyse d’experts humains (temps, précision, taux de faux positifs/faux négatifs).•      Consolidation de la preuve de concept (TRL 5) et préparation des suites de valorisation. title: Solutions Consultant
description_clean:
As OpenSpace's Solutions Consultant for Germany, Austria and Switzerland, you'll be the technical and commercial partner to our Account Executives. You'll win deals by proving the business value of OpenSpace, get new customers live quickly, and drive the adoption that turns first projects into long-term, growing accounts. You'll work across the whole customer lifecycle, from first demo through renewal, with regular visits to customer offices and job sites across the region.
What you will be doing

Owning the technical win with the Account Executive, from discovery and tailored demos through to a signed contract
Scoping, running and closing out pilots and proofs of value, with clear success criteria agreed with the AE and the customer
Finding and qualifying expansion opportunities in existing accounts and building pipeline with the AE
Leading the value and ROI conversation at renewal and expansion, using usage data and customer outcomes to build business cases
Onboarding new customers: project setup, capture training for field teams and admin training for project managers
Driving adoption after go-live through usage reviews, project check-ins and value reviews with customer stakeholders
Answering technical, security and data privacy (GDPR) questions, supporting tenders and RFPs, and advising on integrations such as Autodesk Construction Cloud (Forma)
Bringing market feedback to the Product team and building German-language enablement material with Marketing

What we are looking for

A bachelor's degree in civil engineering, construction management, architecture or a related field, or equivalent work experience
5+ years in a customer-facing role at a construction technology or AEC software company, or in project or site management at an owner or construction company
A proven track record in pre-sales, solutions consulting or customer success with shared revenue targets
Native German and business-fluent English, spoken and written
Ability to travel regularly to customer offices and job sites across DACH
A solid understanding of how construction projects run, from preconstruction to handover, including site documentation and progress tracking
Experience with complex B2B sales cycles, value selling and qualification methods such as MEDDPICC
Familiarity with construction software such as Autodesk Construction Cloud (Forma) and BIM tools
Reality capture or 360° imaging experience is a plus
Knowledge of the DACH construction market and its main contractors is a plus

How you like to work

Commercially minded: You spot expansion opportunities, build the ROI case and help the AE move deals forward. You can turn usage data into a clear story about customer value.
A clear communicator: You adapt your message to site managers, project managers and executives, and you explain technical concepts in plain language.
Organized and independent: You can run several onboardings and pilots at once, and you're comfortable in a small regional team that works closely with colleagues in other countries and time zones.

If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

About Finom
 
Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.

Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.
 
Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.
We're looking for a Senior Android Engineer or Tech Lead who thinks like a product builder — someone who cares deeply about the "why" behind what they're building, not just the tickets in the backlog.
You'll be embedded in a cross-functional domain team (Backend, Mobile, ML/AI, QA, Design, and Product) and own the end-to-end development of features that genuinely matter: company accounts and cash flows, banking transactions, card issuance and management, and AI-enabled accounting. You'll help shape architecture decisions, raise the bar on engineering quality, and mentor the engineers around you.
If you're energized by working at the intersection of great mobile engineering and real product impact — this is the role.
What You’ll Do

Design and build new features for our Android application, used daily by business owners across Europe.
Architect and implement reliable, intuitive solutions for:

Multi-account cash flow management
Banking transactions and payments
Physical and virtual card issuance, activation, and control
AI-powered accounting automation


Build polished, responsive UIs using Jetpack Compose.
Take ownership of code quality, performance, and stability — automated testing and thorough code reviews are non-negotiable.
Collaborate closely with Backend, QA, Design, and Product — you'll be shaping solutions end-to-end, not just implementing specs.
Drive technical decisions within your domain, challenge assumptions when needed, and proactively identify opportunities to build better.
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, tooling, and mobile best practices across the team.

Who You Are
You're pragmatic and have a proven track record of shipping products that matter. You communicate clearly across disciplines and thrive in a cross-functional environment where everyone is solving the same customer problem together.
Your experience includes:

Strong knowledge of Kotlin (Java knowledge is a plus) and 5+ years of commercial Android development.
Deep understanding of OOP, SOLID, and Clean Architecture.
Solid experience with presentation layer patterns — MVI, MVVM, and MVP — and the ability to choose the right one for the context.
Hands-on experience with our core stack:

Reactive programming & async: RxJava, Kotlin Coroutines / Flow
Dependency injection: Dagger 2, Hilt, or Koin
Networking: Retrofit
Navigation: Cicerone, Jetpack Navigation Component
Modern UI: Jetpack Compose


Practical experience with Firebase (FCM, Analytics, Crashlytics).
Experience with Feature-module architecture in production.
Confidence with Git / GitLab, including setting up and maintaining GitLab CI/CD.
A builder's mentality — you care about the product, the users, and the outcomes, not just the code.
Clear, concise communication in English across technical and non-technical audiences.

Nice to Have

Background in fintech or experience with financial products — you understand the stakes.
Solid grasp of mobile security best practices (especially critical in our domain).
Experience profiling and optimizing UI performance — reducing overdraw, improving recomposition efficiency in Jetpack Compose, and hitting smooth 60/120fps rendering.
Hands-on work with performance tooling: Android Profiler, Perfetto, Baseline Profiles, or similar.
Published apps on Google Play you're proud of.
An active GitHub profile with code you're happy to share.
Hands-on experience with AI agents and LLM tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, etc.) — setting up agent environments, writing prompts, skills, and behavioral rules.

Experience with AI-powered IDE tools (Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, etc.) — including agent mode, rules files configuration, and integrating AI into the daily development workflow.
Understanding of model capabilities and limitations — knowing which model fits which task and how to manage the context window effectively.
Ability to evaluate and verify AI-generated output — using automated tests, linters, and critical review to catch hallucinations and errors.
Awareness of AI security risks — prompt injection, data leakage, and safe handling of untrusted inputs in agentic workflows.



Recruitment Flow

Talent Partner Interview
First Technical Interview
Mobile System Design Interview
Team Fit Interview (peer interview)
Offer

What You Will Get In Return
 
Make a genuine impact on the product
 
Join our upward trajectory, and grow with us. We provide the resources and opportunities for continuous personal and professional development, empowering you to make a genuine impact on our evolving product.
 
Work in the EU
 
Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe.
 
Become a stock options holder
 
Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders.
 
Receive unwavering support and care
 
Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling.
 
Work & Swim program
 
Immerse yourself in our exclusive Work & Swim Program. Spend one month in a comfortable corporate apartment in enchanting Cyprus. It's the ideal opportunity to strike the perfect work-life balance while enjoying breathtaking Mediterranean views.
 
Equal Opportunity Statement

title: Product Manager
description_clean: OUR MISSIONTo become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.And we’re a long way from done!THE ROLEBuying and selling a car should feel like one seamless motion for a dealer, not two separate systems. Right now it's the opposite: a dealer buys through us, then has to manage collection, payment and resale largely on their own, stitching together workflows across multiple platforms and channels, much of it manual.For a dealer, speed is money. Every extra day a car sits before it's collected, priced, and paid for is a day of depreciation, tied-up capital, and a missed chance to buy the next one.If we can get a dealer from 'I've bought this car' to 'it's ready and paid for' faster through transport and collections, quicker final pricing, and Wallet, we make them more profitable. A dealer who's more profitable because of Carwow has little reason to go elsewhere: they'll lean on us more, and churn less.This role owns that last-mile agenda: getting cars collected quickly, resolving final price without friction, and making Wallet work the way dealers expect it to. This team sits across our ambitions to make car changing a seamless journey, this role's job is the handover itself: the operational moment between buying and being ready to sell again. description_clean: ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE :École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation.Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être.IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient.Le poste est ouvert au sein le centre RAPSODEE (Recherche d'Albi en génie des Procédés des Solides Divisés, de l'Énergie et de l'Environnement) UMR CNRS 5302 d’IMT Mines Albi, dans le cadre du projet de collaboration avec GRDF sur l’intégration de nouveaux gaz renouvelables dans le réseau de gaz naturel.Les activités du centre RAPSODEE sont structurées en deux groupes de recherche dans les domaines de l’énergie, de l’environnement et du génie particulaire avec un accent particulier sur des procédés durables : plus intenses, plus économes en énergie, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus sûrs. La plateforme VALTHERA est rattachée au centre RAPSODEE. Les travaux réalisés sur la plateforme le sont essentiellement à l’échelle pilote et sont centrés sur les procédés thermochimiques pour la production d’énergies renouvelables.GRDF est le gestionnaire du plus grand réseau de distribution de gaz en Europe. GRDF s’inscrit dans une trajectoire de décarbonation, avec une volonté de multiplier par cinq la production de gaz renouvelable pour attendre 20% de gaz renouvelable dans le réseau GRDF à l’échéance 2030, mais également d’aider les consommateurs de gaz à réduire leur empreinte carbone. Dans ce cadre, GRDF souhait renforcer la connaissance et maîtrise des procédés d'épuration du syngaz, étape clé pour garantir sa compatibilité avec les procédés de méthanation et, à terme, la production de méthane conforme aux exigences d’injection dans le réseau de gaz.DESCRIPTION DU POSTE :En qualité d’ingénieur de recherche, vous intégrerez une équipe comprenant des ingénieurs, techniciens et enseignants chercheurs travaillant dans la recherche sur les procédés thermiques de valorisation de biomasse et déchets.Le projet que vous devrez développer cherche à analyser les différentes technologies d’épuration à intégrer dans une chaîne d’épuration globale de gaz de synthèse. La chaîne d’épuration a un impact conséquent sur les coûts d’investissement et d’opérations du procédé de production de biogaz par gazéification de biomasse ou déchets. Il est essentiel de simplifier le schéma d’épuration et d’essayer de minimiser la génération d’effluents afin de réduire les coûts des opérations unitaires. Le choix des briques technologiques dépend de la qualité du gaz de synthèse produit qui dépend du gisement utilisé, de la technologie du gazéifieur et des conditions opératoires.Le projet n’inclut pas de travail expérimental. Il sera basé exclusivement sur l’analyse bibliographique et la modélisation 0D de la chaîne d’épuration. La modélisation sera réalisée via des logiciels commerciaux et plus idéalement grâce à des logiciels Open source.Les principales tâches que le candidat retenu devra prendre en charge sont :·       La réalisation d’un état de l’art des différentes briques technologies de traitement et d’épuration de biogaz, ainsi que des différentes chaînes existantes dans la littérature.·       Une meilleure appréhension de l’impact de la composition des gisements sur la qualité du gaz en sortie du gazéifieur et l’impact de celui-ci sur la chaine d’épuration.·       L’identification des verrous techniques, des incertitudes et des lacunes de connaissances limitant la maîtrise des différentes briques technologiques.·       Une proposition de modèles des chaines d’épuration (simulation 0D) afin d’établir les bilans de matières et d’énergie et d’estimer la performance globale du procédé.·       L’identification de critères permettant de guider les choix de construction d’une chaîne d’opérations.·       La participation aux réunions de suivi du projet et la rédaction des comptes-rendus de réunion.·       La rédaction de rapports du projet en français et des publications scientifiques en anglais et la création de supports de présentation. CAPACITE ET ATTITUDES :Ce poste nécessite des compétences en génie des procédés, procédés thermiques, thermodynamique et modélisation de procédés. Le candidat doit avoir une expérience dans la modélisation 0D des procédés. La connaissance et la pratique d’un ou plusieurs logiciels de simulation de procédés libres ou commerciaux sera considéré un plus. Le candidat doit faire preuve rigueur, être doté d’un bon sens de l’analyse et savoir travailler en autonomie au sein d’une équipe. Les qualités d’analyse bibliographique et rédactionnelles sont un point essentiel pour ce poste. PROFIL RECHERCHE :·       Vous êtes titulaire d’un doctoratAU-DELÀ DE L’ENVIRONNEMENT PROFESSIONNEL, POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ? :·       cadre de travail agréable dans un campus de 22 ha·       49 jours de congés par an·       restauration administrative sur place·       aide à la mobilité durable pour le transport domicile-travail·       action sociale (protection sociale complémentaire et aide aux familles) INFORMATIONS COMPLÉMENTAIRES :Nature et durée du contrat : CDD 18 moisÀ usage interne :Catégorie du poste et métier de référence : Catégorie II, Métier R – Ingénieur de rechercheLocalisation du poste : IMT Mines AlbiDate limite de candidature : 26/11/2026Date de prise de fonction souhaitée : 01/01/2027La rémunération est fixée selon le profil du candidat (métier, âge, filière d'emploi, durée de garantie salariale), en fonction des règles définies par le cadre de gestion de l'Institut Mines TélécomLes postes offerts au recrutement sont ouverts à toutes et tous avec, sur demande, des aménagements pour les candidates et candidats en situation de handicapEmploi ouvert aux titulaires de catégorie A de la fonction publique et/ou aux personnes contractuellesContacts :o   Sur le contenu du poste : F. title: Senior Control Systems Engineer
description_clean:
Fusionality is building the measurement, simulation and control stack of the fusion energy reactors of the future.
Our technology enables effective and reliable operation, monitoring, and analysis of high-temperature plasmas in fusion devices — which will one day provide clean, practically limitless power to the grid. We have spun out of EPFL’s Swiss Plasma Center and have just completed our pre-seed fundraise.
We are looking for a Senior Control Systems Engineer to join our founding team in Lausanne and help build our core technology.
This job is for you if you are a passionate engineer with deep knowledge cutting across real-time / embedded systems, software and hardware, and excited about building the systems to monitor and control real-world fusion plasmas.
Tasks

Implement real-time control, analysis, data acquisition systems in the kHz to MHz range, as individual contributor and in a team.
Integrate solutions across a variety of company products and services as well as on our in-house test beds.
Provide technical leadership within a growing real-time control and software engineering team that you will help to build.
Translate customer needs into requirements and specifications.

Requirements

Experience taking hard-real-time acquisition and control loops from incomplete requirements through to commissioning on hardware, in domains such as automotive, robotics, embedded, electrical and/or scientific instrumentation.
‘Full stack’: familiarity with all aspects of real-time technologies, from physical/DAQ, real-time software frameworks and middleware, real-time OS and integration.
Fluency in a mix of high-level and low-level languages such as C, C++, Rust, MATLAB/Simulink, Python. Obsession with code quality, testing and reliability.
Experience with distributed real-time systems, real-time networking and field buses and/or SCADA is an advantage.
Experience with embedded/μC/FPGA technologies and/or safety critical systems is an advantage.

Benefits

The unique opportunity to play a foundational role at a dynamic, fast-growing startup, shaping the technical solutions and products from the ground up.
The opportunity to build cutting edge technology to monitor and control plasmas in real fusion devices, working side-by-side with leading plasma and control experts.
Great working conditions, located in Lausanne, Switzerland, a city and country known for its high quality of life.
Competitive salary and equity compensation and benefits including immigration assistance.

If you are excited about joining our team, send your CV including information about a real-time system you have taken into operation. We're looking forward to hearing from you.Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Finance and Operations
description_clean:
People who build lose nearly a quarter of their working time to things that have nothing to do with building. Ferdinand, an electrician and engineer who had founded companies before, started Benetics AI in 2022 to give that time back. Our first product is a voice assistant for the construction site. It works in over 100 languages and every dialect, and nobody has to type.
More than 400 companies in 10+ countries use Benetics AI: electricians, HVAC installers, timber builders, roofers and solar installers. We are bootstrapped, cash-flow positive and growing in triple digits.
We are now hiring someone to run finance and legal while we expand across Europe and into the US.
Tasks
You report to the CEO and take over finance and legal. Today this work is split between the founders, our fiduciary and outside counsel. You bring it into one place and build it out.  
Finance
You own the numbers we run the company on. We are bootstrapped, so no investor money covers a bad month.

Monthly close on a fixed date, with our fiduciary and auditors
Operating model, cash forecast and runway in CHF, EUR and USD
SaaS metrics and billing: ARR, retention, CAC, payback
Cohort analysis, quote-to-cash and revenue recognition
Payroll, insurance and tax

Legal
Sales closes a standard deal without you. When a deal is not standard, they hear back from you within a day.

Contract templates, fallback positions and redlines for order forms, MSAs, partner and supplier agreements and NDAs
GDPR and revDSG, DPAs, subprocessors, TOMs, and the security questionnaires that come with every enterprise deal
Insurance, employment law in CH, DE, FR and the US, and the decision on ISO 27001 or SOC 2

Building the group
We are setting up the US subsidiary right now, and you will own it.

Incorporation, intercompany agreement and transfer pricing between the Swiss parent and the international entity
Registered agent, state registrations, payroll and sales tax nexus
A consolidation that stays clean as we add entities
Choosing the finance and legal tools, and deciding what to automate, what to outsource and what to keep in-house

Requirements

5+ years in finance and in either legal or commercial contracting
Hands-on experience with accounting, payroll and tax
You redline a SaaS contract yourself and know when to call counsel
SaaS finance: subscription revenue, retention cohorts, unit economics, quote-to-cash
Fluent German and English at work. Our customers, our fiduciary and our contracts use both.
You are happy to be the first hire in the function. You build the model and chase the invoices yourself, with no team under you at the start.

Nice to have

You have set up a foreign subsidiary before, including intercompany pricing
Experience with SMB customers and with getting them to pay on time
Views on finance tools and a habit of automating routine work

The role is hands-on for a while and covers both finance and legal. The title will grow with the company.
Benefits

You report to the CEO from day one, and your analysis feeds straight into decisions on pricing, hiring and new markets
A profitable, bootstrapped company with no investor setting the plan. You set the spending rules.
Finance and legal in one role, with the international entities and the group structure as your own build project
Freedom to pick your tools and to automate or outsource anything that does not need you
Office in Zürich, on site Monday to Thursday, flexible hours and holiday planning
A salary band stated upfront, plus participation

How we hire

Introduction, 15-minute video call
Conversation with one of the founders, 30 minutes, about the company, the numbers and the role
A practical case with the team, remote or in Zürich. We work through our real model and one open question together. There is no homework to hand in.
Final conversation and decision. We decide quickly and tell you why.

title: Senior Requirements Engineer Digital Product, 80-100%
description_clean:
PEAX bietet eine Lösung für automatisierten Dokumenteneingang, intelligentes Document Processing und Weiterverarbeitung in nachgelagerten Geschäftsprozessen. Damit werden unsere Kunden von administrativem Aufwand befreit und erkennen den Wert ihrer Daten. Wir suchen Menschen, die unsere Produktentwicklung mit analytischer Tiefe und einem ausgeprägten AI-First-Mindset auf das nächste Level bringen.
Aufgaben
Das bewegst du

Du verantwortest das fachliche Herz unseres Produkts: das Domänenmodell. Capabilities, Business Objects, Business Rules und Prozesse hältst du korrekt, widerspruchsfrei und aktuell. Und du sorgst dafür, dass sie über Domänen hinweg zusammenpassen. 
Aus vielschichtigen, oft widersprüchlichen Anforderungen machst du klare Struktur: Nachvollziehbare Use Cases, scharf geschnittene Anforderungen und eindeutige Akzeptanzkriterien. Dein wichtigster Beitrag ist dabei nicht, jeden Einzelwunsch zu spezifizieren. Es ist zu erkennen, wann mehrere Einzelfälle dasselbe allgemeine Problem sind, und die allgemeine Lösung durchzusetzen. 
Du präzisierst Produktentscheide für die Umsetzung: Regeln, Grenzfälle, Zustände und Sollverhalten. Bei komplexen und domänenübergreifenden Themen führst du die Spezifikation selbst. Im Übrigen setzt du den Standard, nach dem im Team spezifiziert wird, und entwickelst die Modellierungskompetenz deiner Kolleg:innen weiter. 
Qualität ist für dich Teil der Spezifikationsarbeit und kein nachgelagerter Schritt. Du erstellst E2E-Testkonzepte und Testfälle für deinen Bereich und prüfst Features. Wir sind ein kleines Team, in dem alle die Qualität des Produkts mittragen. 
Du bist für die von dir verantworteten Features die fachliche Ansprechperson für Engineering, Design, Customer Success und Sales sowie für Partner, Reseller und Kunden. Du bist auch die Person, die „so geht das fachlich nicht“ sagen kann und dafür gehört wird. 
Deine Arbeit startet in der Product Discovery: Bei der Problemrahmung, nicht erst bei der Übersetzung fertiger Entscheide. Zudem bringst du deine fachliche Sicht in Architekturentscheide ein, wo sie Konsequenzen für das Domänenmodell haben. 
PEAX baut gerade agentische Architekturen. Du nutzt AI-Tools strukturiert und verantwortungsvoll als Bestandteil unseres Requirement Engineering Prozesses.

Qualifikation
Das bringst du mit

Mehrjährige Senior-Erfahrung als Requirements Engineer, Business Analyst oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle im B2B-SaaS-Produktumfeld, idealerweise in einer Scale-up-Phase und mit Hintergrund in Document Management, ECM, Workflow-Automatisierung oder einem verwandten Information-Hub-Umfeld. Du hast dabei nachweisbar Verantwortung für fachliche Modelle getragen und nicht nur für Spezifikationsdokumente. 
Ausbildungshintergrund in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Business Engineering, BWL mit IT-Affinität (FH, Universität). MSc-Niveau ideal, Bachelor mit entsprechender Senior-Erfahrung ebenfalls möglich. 
Echte Modellierungstiefe: Du kannst ein Geschäftsproblem in Entitäten, Zustände, Regeln und Prozesse zerlegen, so dass das Ergebnis widerspruchsfrei ist. Du formulierst Akzeptanzkriterien so, dass sie prüfbar sind. Sicherer Umgang mit BPMN, UML, Use Cases und User Stories sowie mit Jira und Confluence. Kenntnisse in ArchiMate sind ein Pluspunkt.

title: Founding Marketing Manager
description_clean:
Important: this role is based in our offices in Chiasso, Switzerland, and is open to EU citizens only.About Anthropos
Anthropos is the Enterprise AI transformation platform. We help companies map, verify, and develop the skills of their workforce with AI Simulations, AI Labs, AI Interviews, and our AI Academy. Enterprises in energy, transportation, and technology use us to answer a question no HR system can: what can our people actually do, and are they ready for AI?
We are a global team that has been building in the skills and assessment space for more than a decade. Most of us built and scaled a previous company in this exact market to a successful exit. Now we are doing it again, with AI at the core.
The role
You will be our first marketing hire, and you will own marketing.
There is no playbook to inherit and no team to delegate to on day one. You will work side by side with our CEO and founder and with the sales team, from our offices in Chiasso, and your job is to build the machine that grows our pipeline, our brand, and ultimately our revenue.
This is an operator role, not a strategy-only role. You will write the copy, ship the campaign, run the event, look at the data, and decide what to do next. If that excites you more than managing an agency, keep reading.
What you'll do

Demand generation. Design and run campaigns that put qualified enterprise buyers (CHROs, HR and Engineering leaders, CTOs) in front of our sales team. You own the pipeline number with them.
SEO and GEO. Grow our organic presence on search engines and inside AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity). Being found by AI is as important to us as being found by Google, and we are early enough that you can win here.
Events. Plan and run our presence at conferences, executive dinners, and our own events, end to end: pick them, organize them, work the room, follow up.
Content and brand. Shape how Anthropos sounds and looks in public: website, blog, LinkedIn, email, sales materials. Make the brand feel as good as the product.
Measurement. Instrument what you do, report on what worked, kill what didn't, and double down fast.
Structure. As things start working, turn them into repeatable processes and eventually into a team you help build.

Who you are

An entrepreneur at heart who knows marketing. You treat the function like your own business: you spot opportunities, act without waiting for permission, and own the outcome. Behind that instinct is real experience: years of generalist marketing in startups across demand gen, content, events, and product marketing, so you know which levers actually move pipeline.
Someone who gets things done. You are extremely operational. You default to doing, not briefing someone else to do, and you bring results fast. You like being measured on them.
An expert with Claude Code, or a heavy daily user of it. We use AI in a very advanced way across the whole company, and we expect marketing to work the same way: producing at a pace and volume a traditional marketer can't match. This is a real requirement, not a nice-to-have.
Confident in a startup that moves very fast. We change direction quickly, the bar is high, and some days are stressful. In exchange, you will learn more in a year here than in five anywhere else. You need to genuinely want that trade.
A big risk-taker. You launch things that might fail, test channels nobody assigned you, and own the result either way.
Not looking for a nine-to-five. This is a startup job, and we are honest about what that means: we work quite a lot. If what you want is a predictable 9-to-5, this is not the right fit, and that's okay. If you want the intensity because of what you get to build, own, and learn, you will feel at home.
Fluent in written and spoken English, at a near-perfect level. Most of what you produce will be read by an international audience. Italian is a plus.
An EU citizen. Hiring non-EU citizens in Switzerland requires more time and we cannot currently afford that.
Able to work from our offices in Chiasso, Ticino. We work in person, with one remote day per week (Thursdays). You need to live in, or be ready to move to, an area where you can commute to Chiasso every day: the provinces of Como, Milan or Varese (Italy), or Switzerland. Relocation support is available where possible.

What you'll get

CHF 42,000–50,000 per year, plus a very generous stock package. We'd rather be upfront: this is a startup salary paired with real ownership in the company, and the upside grows with the business you help build.
Relocation support, where available, if you are not already in the area.
The ability to grow very fast. You start as our first marketing hire; if you deliver, you build and lead the function. No queue of people ahead of you.
A direct working relationship with the founder and the sales team: short feedback loops, no layers.
The tools to work like it's the AI era: Claude Code, our own platform, and budget for what you need.

Wil jij met jouw technische kennis de brug slaan tussen product en klant in een ambitieuze hardware-startup die de glastuinbouw verduurzaamt? Als Application Engineer ben jij het eerste technische aanspreekpunt voor onze klanten en het salesteam. 
BAAN · FULLTIME · ROTTERDAM 
THERMELEON | Richting klimaatneutrale glastuinbouw 
Ons product – de Thermeleon Warmtebatterij – is een innovatieve etmaalbuffer voor kassen. Het verbetert de energie-efficiëntie van kassen door de overtollige warmte strategisch te hergebruiken tijdens de dag-nachtcyclus. Zo verlagen we het aardgasgebruik substantieel en is er een hogere klimaatgelijkheid over de kas heen. In deze rol ben jij de technische schakel tussen ons Sales-team en onze klanten (telers). Je beantwoordt zelfstandig de meerderheid van de technische vragen die vanuit sales binnenkomen, en zorgt ervoor dat alleen de complexere vraagstukken bij het Tech-team terechtkomen. Je valt onder Operations en werkt nauw samen met zowel Sales als het technische team.
Tasks
WAT GA JE DOEN 
Je bent eerstelijns technisch aanspreekpunt voor vragen die vanuit Sales binnenkomen 
Je vertaalt technische vraagstukken naar heldere, begrijpelijke antwoorden voor klanten en salescollega's 
Je handelt zelfstandig het grootste deel van de technische vragen af die vanuit sales binnenkomen 
Je herkent en prioriteert complexere technische issues en zet deze gestructureerd door naar het Tech-team 
Je ondersteunt Sales bij offertes, demo's en klantgesprekken waar technische diepgang nodig is 
Je denkt actief mee over hoe het technische proces en de klantvraag beter op elkaar aansluiten
Requirements
WAT WE ZOEKENJe hebt een technische studie-achtergrond (bijvoorbeeld Werktuigbouwkunde, Natuurkunde, Chemical Engineering of vergelijkbaar) 
Je hebt affiniteit met klantcontact en commercieel inzicht 
Je bent een sterke communicator die technische inhoud helder over kan brengen aan een niet-technisch publiek 
Je bent zelfstandig en oplossingsgericht, en schakelt makkelijk tussen techniek en klantrelatie 
Ervaring in een vergelijkbare rol (bijvoorbeeld Technical Sales, Asset Reliability Specialist, Application Engineer) is een pré 
Passie voor duurzame innovatie en hardware
Benefits
WAT WIJ BIEDEN 
Je bouwt het data-platform vanaf de grond af aan, met veel eigen inbreng in tooling en architectuur 
Ruimte om door te groeien richting een leidende rol binnen het team 
Je werkt aan een concreet, impactvol probleem: het optimaliseren van het energieverbruik van kassen 
Een inkijkje in een startup: bijbehorende financiering, subsidies, etc. 
Multidisciplinaire samenwerking: met Sales, Operations en het R&D-team
ONS TEAM 
Thermeleon bestaat uit een enthousiast en gevarieerd team dat is gedreven door een duurzame ideologie en een passie voor de glastuinbouw. Momenteel bevinden we ons in de startup-fase, waarbij de metingen bij de klant in een high-tech kas in volle gang zijn. Om te blijven leren (van elkaar), organiseren we elke vrijdag een 'Therming Sessie' om kennis te delen en de week af te sluiten. 
We zijn onderdeel van het duurzame-startup innovatieprogramma van de Europese Unie (Climate-KIC) en ontvangen ook subsidie van het NWO-domein Toegepaste en Technische Wetenschappen (TTW) in samenwerking met de TU Delft. 
WERKLOCATIE 
Ons kantoor bevindt zich in de monumentale Van Nellefabriek in Rotterdam.

Wij streven naar diversiteit in het team! Dit geldt zowel in opleiding, achtergrond, specialisatie, en man/vrouw verdeling. Onderzoek toont aan dat mannen zich zelfverzekerd genoeg voelen om te solliciteren als ze aan 60% van de eisen voldoen, terwijl vrouwelijke kandidaten alleen solliciteren als ze elke box aantikken. title: Product Designer- Cloud

At Mendix, we empower organizations to build, deploy, and govern modern applications using our low-code platform. With the resources of a large company and the innovation of a software leader, we create solutions that enable our customers to achieve more.

We make complex cloud capabilities, administration, and integrations easier to use. You'll help shape a new agentic platform, working with product managers, technical leads, and developers to frame problems, validate ideas, and deliver well-crafted experiences, including interactions between people and AI agents. AI is central to what we build and how we work. We value strong UX and UI craft through clear thinking, communication, rapid prototyping, and attention to the implemented experience, not just polished design files.

Deliver detailed UI and interaction designs, including how people guide, review, and correct AI agents. Apply existing design-system patterns and contribute improvements where needed.
Work closely with developers through implementation and conduct design QA to improve usability and experience quality.
Communicate decisions clearly, share work in progress, and own defined problems with guidance while collaborating on more complex challenges.

Around 2–5 years of relevant product design experience and a design degree or equivalent practical experience.
Strong UX, interaction, and UI design skills, with experience using design systems.
Hands-on experience using AI in research and design workflows and building functional prototypes with AI-assisted coding tools.
Experience validating concepts, testing usability, and collaborating with product managers and developers.
Initiative, comfort with ambiguity, and willingness to challenge assumptions and learn from feedback.
Clear written and spoken English, with the ability to articulate ideas and explain design decisions.

Preferred Skills:

Experience designing AI-powered or human–agent experiences.
Experience with B2B SaaS, enterprise software, cloud platforms, deployment, operations, or governance.
