title: Intelligence Center X Engineering Manager - EMEA
description_clean:
Build and lead the team that brings Intelligence Center X to life for leading companies across the EMEA, through business-relevant enterprise agentic AI use cases.
About Intelligence Center X
Intelligence Center X (ICX) is Siemens' industrial AI platform. ICX combines Siemens' own core graph, ontology, machine learning and agentic AI technology with our industrial software foundations to bring truly differentiated capabilities to market. It connects a company's enterprise and operational data into an enterprise ontology, and uses machine learning and agentic AI to reason over it and act on it.
Our customers are leaders in automotive, aerospace and defense, semiconductors and electronics, industrial machinery, pharma and financial services.
How we engage with customers
Beyond typical demos, we work forward-deployed with the customer — on relevant data, against their problem — and build a working agentic AI solution, grounded in an enterprise ontology. It is how we establish value with customers: where they see the use case come to life, and where we earn the right to move forward.Key ResponsibilitiesThe role
As the ICX Engineering Manager for the EMEA, you build and lead the EMEA team of ICX Engineers — a presales FDE team that leads the ideation and creation of these engagements. They model a customer's domain as an enterprise ontology, build agents and machine learning that reason over it and act on it, and deliver working agentic applications that compel customers to invest in Intelligence Center X with Siemens.
This is a formal people-management role, and a player-coach one. You:

Lead by example — build customer solutions yourself, and set the bar for how the team builds them.
Are a senior presence on key opportunities — with customers, and alongside sales leadership.
Recruit and grow the team — hire strong engineers, and develop them.
Evolve the global practice — work with global ICX leaders on how we engage with customers across every zone.

You work alongside sales teams and strategic partners, and report to the EMEA Pre-Sales Leader.
What your team's work looks like

In a given week, one of your engineers is connecting quality and supplier data for an aerospace manufacturer to find why defects keep reaching its customers. Another is building an agentic assistant that helps a pharma company make batch release decisions in hours rather than days. You are with a third customer's leadership team, shaping the next engagement. Your job is to make sure each one lands — and that what one engineer learns, the next one starts with.
RequirementsWho you are

You lead technical teams that work with customers. Through formal management or team-lead roles, you have led customer-facing FDE, presales, services or other technical teams.
You are hands-on with agentic AI and ontology. You still build, and your team follows your example.
You are entrepreneurial. You take ownership, move at startup pace and find a route to an outcome before the problem is fully defined — with some of the largest companies in the world.
You think in business value, and you are credible with customers and sales leadership alike.

Skills and experience
We look for experience or strong potential in the following areas.

Leading technical teams — formal management or team-lead roles for customer-facing FDE, presales, services or other technical teams.
Technical consulting leadership — leading client engagements and delivery teams in agentic AI, data and analytics at a consultancy or systems integrator.
Recruiting and developing engineers — hiring strong people, coaching them and growing their careers.
Senior customer presence — leading working sessions with technical and business stakeholders, including executives, on key opportunities.
Data engineering and analytics — making sense of how a company's data is spread across its systems, bringing it together and modelling it.
Modern data and AI platforms — experience working with platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, Google Cloud, AWS data lakes, Palantir or C3.ai.
Agentic AI — designing agents and AI solutions grounded in enterprise data: LLMs, retrieval, tool use, MCP.
Agentic development tools — Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or similar, used to build quickly and well.
Enterprise ontology — modelling a real business domain as an ontology or knowledge graph and putting it to work in an enterprise.
Machine learning and data science — building models that solve real business problems, such as forecasting, anomaly detection or classification.
Experience in our industries — manufacturing, engineering, supply chain, pharma, aerospace or financial services.

Travel
Some travel is expected, up to 25%. For people who want to spend even more time on site with customers, there is room for it.Why Join Us

Grow with ICX. Lead as Siemens brings Intelligence Center X to the market as a leading industrial AI platform.
Build and lead a team. ICX Engineering is growing fast, and you shape both the Americas team and the global practice.
The problem every enterprise is working on. Agentic AI grounded in a company's own data and context.
A direct line to product. Your team's engagements help shape the ICX roadmap.



At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

title: Kosmetiker / Skin Therapist – Laser-Haarentfernung (NiSV)
description_clean: Über Aever ClinicsAever Clinics gehört zu einer wachsenden europäischen Klinikgruppe im Bereich Beauty, Hautgesundheit und ästhetische Behandlungen. Wir verbinden moderne Technologien, hochwertige Behandlungen und eine persönliche Betreuung, um unseren Kund erstklassige Ergebnisse zu ermöglichen.Für unseren Standort in Hamburg im Westfield Hamburg-Überseequartier suchen wir eine engagierte und kundenorientierte Kosmetikerin oder einen engagierten Kosmetiker, die oder der unser Team verstärkt und gemeinsam mit uns wachsen möchte.Deine AufgabenBeratung und KundenbetreuungDu führst professionelle Beratungsgespräche sowie Haut- und Körperanalysen durch.Du verstehst die Wünsche und Bedürfnisse unserer Kund und berätst sie zu geeigneten Behandlungen.Du erklärst Behandlungsabläufe, mögliche Ergebnisse und die richtige Nachsorge verständlich und kompetent.Du baust durch deine freundliche Art und deine fachliche Kompetenz langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf.Durchführung von BehandlungenDu führst Laser-Haarentfernungen sowie weitere Haut-, Körper- und ästhetische Behandlungen entsprechend deiner Qualifikation und unserer angebotenen Leistungen durch.Du arbeitest nach unseren Behandlungsstandards, Protokollen und Sicherheitsvorgaben.Du sorgst für eine angenehme Behandlungsatmosphäre sowie für höchste Hygiene- und Qualitätsstandards.Du dokumentierst die Behandlungen sorgfältig und gibst deinen Kund passende Nachsorgeempfehlungen.Qualität, Sicherheit und GeräteDu beachtest alle geltenden Sicherheits-, Hygiene- und Behandlungsrichtlinien.Du erkennst mögliche Kontraindikationen und klärst offene Fragen vor der Behandlung.Du setzt die Geräte fachgerecht und entsprechend deiner Schulungen ein.Du achtest auf die Einsatzbereitschaft der Behandlungsräume und Geräte und meldest technische Probleme zeitnah.Kundenbindung und TeamarbeitDu sorgst für ein hochwertiges Kundenerlebnis vom ersten Beratungsgespräch bis zur Nachbetreuung.Du empfiehlst passende Behandlungspläne und Pakete auf Grundlage der individuellen Kundenbedürfnisse.Du trägst durch guten Service und kompetente Beratung zur Kundenzufriedenheit, Kundenbindung und zum Erfolg der Klinik bei.Du arbeitest eng mit dem Clinic Manager und dem gesamten Team zusammen und unterstützt einen reibungslosen Klinikalltag.Das bringst du mitEine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als staatlich anerkannte Kosmetiker oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation im Bereich Kosmetik, Hautpflege oder Ästhetik.Eine gültige NiSV-Fachkunde für die Anwendung nichtionisierender Strahlung zu kosmetischen Zwecken ist erforderlich.Idealerweise praktische Erfahrung mit Laser-Haarentfernung sowie weiteren apparativen oder ästhetischen Behandlungen.Interesse an moderner Hautpflege, innovativen Behandlungstechnologien und ästhetischen Dienstleistungen.Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.Ein professionelles, freundliches Auftreten und Freude am Umgang mit Menschen.Eine sorgfältige, zuverlässige und verantwortungsbewusste Arbeitsweise.Teamgeist, Eigeninitiative und die Motivation, dich fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln.Das bieten wir dirAttraktives Bonussystem und die Möglichkeit, aktiv zum Erfolg der Klinik beizutragen.Kostenlose Behandlungen und Mitarbeiterrabatte.Regelmäßige Schulungen sowie Möglichkeiten zur fachlichen Weiterentwicklung.Die Chance, mit modernen Geräten und innovativen Behandlungstechnologien zu arbeiten.Ein motiviertes Team und ein internationales, wachsendes Unternehmen.Perspektiven für deine berufliche Entwicklung innerhalb von Aever Clinics.Entwicklungspotenzial: Wenn du Engagement zeigst, Verantwortung übernehmen möchtest und dich fachlich title: CENTRALE LYON - Doctorat Modélisation prédictive de matériaux polymères recyclés par inférence statistique et apprentissage machine hybride.
description_clean: ContexteLe projet MIAM, soutenu par l’Institut Carnot Ingénierie@Lyon, propose une thèse de doctorat de 36 mois au sein du Laboratoire de Tribologie et Dynamique des Systèmes (LTDS UMR CNRS 5513, Ecole Centrale de Lyon, Ecully, France). Ce travail de recherche s’inscrit dans une collaboration étroite entre les équipes DySCo du LTDS et les laboratoires partenaires comme le LAMCOS (INSA de Lyon) et du Centre Technique Industriel (CTI) de la Plasturgie et des Composites français (IPC). L’objectif scientifique est de lever les verrous liés à la variabilité des matières plastiques recyclées en développant des stratégies d’apprentissage machine et d’inférence statistique capables de garantir une qualité de 1 production stable malgré l’hétérogénéité des gisements de matériaux. Le cœur des travaux portera sur le développement d’une structure d’apprentissage originale permettant de fusionner des données expérimentales réelles avec des données synthétiques issues de simulations numériques. Le candidat devra concevoir des modèles prédictifs robustes, souvent qualifiés de jumeaux numériques, pour assurer un pilotage des procédés en temps réel. Cette approche vise à réduire drastiquement les délais de mise en œuvre de nouveaux matériaux innovants tout en maintenant une fidélité physique stricte, assurant ainsi que les modèles ne soient pas de simples corrélations statistiques mais reflètent la réalité mécanique. Cas d’étude Le cas d’application principal retenu pour cette recherche est le développement d’un capteur virtuel appliqué à la rhéologie au sein des lignes de transformation de l’IPC. En instrumentant les étapes de mélange et d’injection, le doctorant cherchera à prédire les propriétés finales de la matière, telles que la viscosité et le comportement des granulés, en fonction des réglages machines. Ce cas offre un terrain d’étude idéal pour tester la résilience des algorithmes face à des conditions de production changeantes.  Profil recherchéLe profil recherché pour cette thèse est celui d’un candidat possédant une double compétence affirmée en intelligence artificielle et en modélisation physique des matériaux. Une maîtrise des outils de programmation et une sensibilité aux problématiques industrielles sont indispensables pour mener à bien les missions de ce projet. Les travaux se dérouleront principalement à l’École Centrale de Lyon, avec des échanges réguliers entre les sites d’Écully, de Villeurbanne et d’Oyonnax, et bénéficieront d’un environnement scientifique de haut niveau dédié à l’innovation dans le domaine des matériaux et des procédés.Type de contratLe contrat sera un CDD de type contrat doctoral ’avec activité (diffusion d’informations scientifiques et/ou expertise)’ géré par Centrale Lyon. La rémunération sera d’approximativement 2035€ net par mois sur 36 mois.Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

description_clean: Legal AI is only as good as the knowledge behind it. At Lefebvre Sdu, we’ve been building that knowledge for 200 years. Day in, day out. Law by law. Word by word. This is not a pilot project: the platform runs in production and is used heavily every day.As a medior, your focus is on building. You break down a legal process, translate it into a technical process and work out how to best connect the pieces. Stuck on something? title: (Senior) GEO Manager (m/w/d)
description_clean: At idealo, we've built a strong SEO foundation. Now, we're looking to take the next step. As AI-powered search experiences such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, and Gemini increasingly influence how people research products and make purchasing decisions, we want to ensure idealo becomes a trusted and frequently cited source within these new shopping journeys.As our GEO Manager, you'll take ownership of developing Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) as an additional growth discipline alongside our established SEO activities. Combining your technical SEO expertise with hands-on experience in AI search optimization, you'll develop our GEO strategy, establish meaningful visibility monitoring, and drive experimentation to understand what makes content and data discoverable, relevant, and citable by generative AI systems.You'll work closely with our SEO team and collaborate across Product, Engineering, Content, Brand, and Communications to turn emerging opportunities into scalable solutions.About your new roleGEO Strategy & Development: You develop and drive idealo's GEO strategy and experimentation roadmap, building on our existing SEO foundation. You identify opportunities across generative search platforms and AI-assisted shopping journeys, translating emerging developments into actionable initiatives aligned with our broader SEO and business objectives.AI Visibility & Performance Monitoring: You establish and continuously improve a GEO monitoring framework covering platforms such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews. You define relevant KPIs, including mention and citation rates, share of voice, sentiment, and positioning within AI-generated answers, and develop dashboards that make performance and progress transparent to different stakeholders.Technical GEO Optimization: You leverage your technical SEO expertise to improve how generative AI systems discover, interpret, and reference idealo's content. This includes optimizing structured data (Schema.org), semantic relationships, product and offer information, and identifying technical opportunities to strengthen our visibility and accessibility across AI-powered search experiences.Experimentation & Competitive Analysis: You design, implement, and evaluate GEO experiments, analyze idealo's visibility against relevant competitors, and translate findings into concrete optimization measures. You continuously assess emerging GEO tools, methodologies, and platform capabilities to improve our approach.AI Shopping & Content Optimization: You explore how idealo's product, pricing, and offer data can become a valuable information source for AI agents and agentic commerce. Together with Content Marketing, you assess existing content and develop answer-focused, well-structured formats that strengthen relevance, authority, and citation potential.Cross-functional Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing: You connect technical SEO and GEO requirements with Product and Engineering initiatives and collaborate with Brand and Communications/PR on authority-building and digital PR opportunities. You actively share your expertise, communicate findings to stakeholders, and contribute insights from the evolving AI search landscape to idealo's long-term SEO strategy.Skills & Requirements3-5 years of hands-on SEO experience, with a clear focus on technical SEO. Strong technical SEO fundamentals: site architecture, crawlability, indexing, Core Web Vitals, JavaScript SEO, and experience running full technical audits. Practical understanding of how generative search systems retrieve, summarize, and cite content.Experience with data analysis, KPI definition, and translating data into recommendations. Hands-on proficiency with core SEO tools (Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs or Semrush, Screaming Frog or similar crawler). Familiarity with structured data, semantic models, and entity-based SEO. Experience with GEO/AI visibility tools (e.g., Profound, AirOps, Rankscale, Peec AI, Otterly). Strong AI mindset: willing to test new GEO tools and methods and share learnings with the team. Excellent communication skills, able to present technical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders across Engineering, Product, Content, Brand, and Communications/PR. Experience in e-commerce, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL or reporting automation with tools such as n8n are a plus.At idealo you can expectYou want to further your education? title: Growth Manager (m/f/d)
description_clean: Wir verwalten über 70.000 Einheiten in ganz Deutschland. Das ist nicht das Geschäft, das ist die Plattform. Darauf bauen wir neue Verticals auf: Versicherung, Energie, Finanzierung und Brokerage. Für Brokerage suchen wir jetzt die Person, die daraus ein echtes Geschäft macht.Darum geht esViele unserer Eigentümer wollen irgendwann verkaufen oder neu vermieten. Wir sitzen direkt an der Quelle und kennen Objekte, Eigentümer und Timing. Deine Aufgabe ist, daraus eine planbare Akquise-Maschine zu bauen: Du identifizierst die richtigen Eigentümer aus unserem Bestand, sprichst sie gezielt an und wandelst erstes Interesse in hochqualifizierte Leads für unsere Makler um.Das ist keine Strategie-Rolle mit Folien und Roadmaps. Du baust selbst: Kampagnen, Outbound-Workflows, Automatisierungen, Funnels. Du weißt jede Woche, welche Zahl du bewegt hast. Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Leadership-Team, ohne Hierarchie-Ebenen dazwischen.Was du machstAkquise-Engine aufbauen: Du analysierst unseren Bestand, findest Eigentümer mit Verkaufs- oder Vermietungsbedarf und baust Workflows für Datenanreicherung, Lead-Scoring und automatisierte Ansprache.Marketing selbst umsetzen: Du baust und optimierst die Kanäle, die Leads bringen, von Outbound über Performance-Kampagnen bis zu In-App-Triggern im richtigen Moment.Funnel und Zahlen verantworten: Du definierst KPIs vom Lead bis zum Mandat, trackst Kosten pro Lead und Conversion und optimierst so lange, bis die Unit Economics stimmen.Schnell testen: Daten-Trigger, Kanäle, Messaging und Lead-Magneten. Du hast eine klare Meinung, was du ausprobieren willst, und misst es sauber.Was du mitbringst3+ Jahre operative Erfahrung in Growth oder Performance Marketing, mit eigener Verantwortung für Leads, Conversion oder Umsatz.Du hast Dinge von null aufgebaut, etwa als Gründer:in, als Geschäftsführer:in eines kleinen Unternehmens oder in einer frühen Startup-Phase. Das ist für uns ein starkes Signal.Hands-on-Erfahrung mit datengetriebener Akquise: Outbound, Datenanreicherung, CRM und Automatisierung.Marketing-Erfahrung mit Performance-Kanälen und Kampagnen ist ein klares Plus.Erfahrung in Immobilien, PropTech oder Marktplätzen ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (mindestens C1). Du sprichst täglich mit Eigentümern und unseren Hausverwaltungen.Du lebst in Berlin oder ziehst her und reist gern zu unseren Standorten in ganz Deutschland.Bitte nicht bewerben, wenndu vor allem Strategie machen und die Umsetzung anderen überlassen willst,du erst ein Team führen möchtest, bevor das Modell bewiesen ist,du nicht bereit bist, in Berlin zu arbeiten.Was wir bietenEin Vertical, das du von Anfang an prägst, mit 70.000 Einheiten als Basis und voller Rückendeckung vom Leadership-Team.Ein Inside-Sales-Team, auf das du zugreifen kannst: Es übernimmt Anrufe und die Bearbeitung deiner Kampagnen, damit du dich auf den Aufbau der Akquise-Engine konzentrieren kannst.Einen direkten Weg zur Verantwortung: Wenn Brokerage funktioniert, skalierst du es weiter.Top-Vergütung inklusive virtueller Aktienoptionen und 500 € Wohnzuschuss pro Monat in der Nähe unseres Büros.110 € Lunch-Budget und 50 € Fitness-Zuschuss pro Monat, täglich Frühstück und Spezialitäten-Kaffee im Office.1.200 € Weiterbildungsbudget pro Jahr.Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Role summary
How much numerical precision does an LLM need, and where in the model architecture does it matter most? When does quantization improve runtime, and what does it cost in model quality?
We're looking for a motivated working student to help turn these questions into experiments and experiments into maintainable code. You'll explore optimization methods and build reusable evaluation tooling. You'll work closely with our quantization, compiler, and runtime engineers, and your findings will directly influence how we optimize models for Tensordyne hardware.
What you will do

Model quality evaluation: Measure how low-precision computation affects performance on coding and reasoning benchmarks. Diagnose where quantization has the greatest impact.
Quantization research: Implement and compare post-training quantization methods to improve inference efficiency while preserving task accuracy.

InMobi Group is a global technology company shaping the future of agentic commerce and advertising. Glance is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. To learn more, visit advertising.inmobi.com.
Glance
Glance is an intelligent shopping agent, redefining the commerce experience. Powered by proprietary agentic intelligence and generative AI, Glance delivers a hyper-personalized consumer experience across mobile and TV — shaping the new era of shopping. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com.
Overview of the Role:
InMobi is seeking a passionate, ambitious, and driven Senior Sales Manager to drive new logo activation for InMobi's App Performance Solutions team across the DACH region and broader EMEA market. In this role, you'll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and closing high-value opportunities with some of the largest brands across non-gaming verticals. This is a high-impact, quota-carrying role ideal for a self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, data-driven environment and is passionate about helping performance marketers scale through programmatic app advertising.
You'll join a high-performing team spanning EMEA Sales, Client Growth, and Media Buying under App Performance Solutions — a team that will actively support your growth and success within the InMobi programmatic sales ecosystem. This is an exciting opportunity to make a visible impact across the EMEA region for a high-growth App Performance Solutions business comprising an AI/ML-driven DSP, Owned and Operated Glance TV, and Performance CTV.
This is a role for true hunters — those who thrive on building pipelines from scratch, opening doors others can't, and turning cold conversations into long-term revenue partnerships.
This is a fully remote role based in Germany. Proficiency in both German and English is required. Some travel is expected for client meetings, industry events, and in-person team sync-ups as needed.

The Impact You'll Make: 
As Senior Sales Manager, EMEA, you will be responsible for driving sales from a portfolio of Direct Brands and Performance Agencies across the DACH region by creating and selling effective App Performance Solutions. You will also actively participate in shaping InMobi's App Performance sales strategy, go-to-market approach, and execution plan across your key region within EMEA.

Identify, acquire, advise, and develop new relationships with targeted, strategic brands, agencies, and partners that ensure the growth and long-term success of InMobi's suite of App Performance Solutions
 Leverage your knowledge of the market landscape and InMobi's unique selling propositions and differentiators to develop new and enduring business with advertisers — including navigating the Programmatic and walled garden ecosystems to position InMobi App Performance Solutions as a must-have for brands' app growth and retention strategies
 Maintain strong relationships with ecosystem influencers, MMPs, agencies, and partners to keep InMobi top of mind for their clients
 Own the entire sales lifecycle — from outbound prospecting and inbound lead qualification to proposal building, nurturing, activation, and strategic growth consulting
 Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams across Client Growth, Media Buying, Legal, Finance, Ecosystem Partnerships, and Product to ensure seamless onboarding, execution, and account handover to the Growth team
 Represent InMobi App Performance Solutions at key industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities across EMEA to drive visibility and pipeline growth
 Maintain a disciplined approach to pipeline management, leveraging CRM tools for accurate forecasting and performance tracking
 Consistently exceed quarterly revenue targets through strategic account acquisition and strong client relationship management


The Experience We Need: 

 Industry experience. You bring 5+ years of hunting and selling experience to App businesses and Performance Agencies. You understand the challenges they face, can leverage your experience to develop compelling solutions, and have a track record of consistently meeting and exceeding revenue goals. You're known for building revenue where none existed — not just maintaining books of business, but creating them.
 An advertising technology expert. You've spent at least 6+ years in ad tech and know the EMEA ecosystem well. Experience at a leading Performance DSP, Performance CTV, Ad Network, Rewarded Platform, MMP, or other online advertising company is required. You think deeply about clients' growth and retention challenges and know how to recommend the right solutions.
 A trusted advisor and consultant. You have authentic communication skills and the ability to form consultative, credible, and long-standing relationships with your clients. In a marketplace flooded with vendors, your clients think of you first — not because you sold them, but because you solved for them.
 A high-energy, passionate self-starter. You are highly self-motivated by nature, ambition is in your DNA, and you are extremely comfortable in a fast-paced, risk-taking, and often ambiguous environment.
 Analytically strong and a compelling storyteller. You have strong analytical skills and the ability to peel back layers and find hidden opportunities. You don't just present numbers — you build narratives around them that move clients to action.
 A proactive problem solver. You have a proven ability to solve customer pain points and technical challenges while proactively creating solutions through cross-functional collaboration.
 Eager, curious, and a fast learner. You are naturally inquisitive, take a proactive approach, and seek out ways to support your colleagues. The ad tech landscape shifts constantly — signal loss, AI disruption, shifting buyer behaviour — and you lean in rather than wait for the dust to settle.
 Education. A BA/BS degree in a relevant discipline is required, or equivalent professional experience. An MBA or Master's degree is a plus.
 Language. Full professional proficiency in both German and English is required. 


At InMobi, you'll be surrounded by people who:

Think big and act fast — we're entrepreneurial, thrive in ambiguity, and love solving high-impact problems
Are passionate, fanatically driven, and take immense pride in their work — we care deeply about the impact we create and continuously push our potential
Own their outcomes — we take responsibility, make bold decisions, and execute with confidence
Embrace freedom with accountability — we value autonomy and understand that trust comes with responsibility
Believe in lifelong learning — we welcome feedback, challenge ourselves to grow, and aren't afraid to take smart risks

Our compensation philosophy enables us to provide a competitive salary that drives high performance while balancing business needs and pay equity. We determine compensation based on a wide variety of factors, including role, nature of experience, skills, and location.

The base salary or fixed pay for this role ranges from €132,500 to €167,250 (min to max of base salary). In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible to receive variable compensation in the form of an annual or quarterly performance bonus or sales incentive, as determined per InMobi policy.

InMobi is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, ethnic origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion or belief, disability, age, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law, including the German General Equal Treatment Act (Allgemeines Gleichbehandlungsgesetz — AGG).

title: Golang Backend Engineer, Financial Product Fraud
description_clean:
Our Global Structure
Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.Your job is to make sure every payout and transaction lands with the right person.
We have spent years getting very good at protecting the things a marketplace has always had to protect: checkout fraud, account takeover, courier abuse. But we are no longer only a marketplace. We now issue banking products, lend to merchants, move instant payouts to couriers, and collect cash on the doorstep. Every one of those is a new way for money to leave the platform.
This is a new team, and it owns that surface: fraud wherever money moves through the platform. Who receives it, who lends it, who collects it, and who holds it in a financial account. Think instant payout rails, merchant cash advances, and platform-issued banking and earned-wage products serving millions of couriers and merchants. These are live loss surfaces, and the volume grows with every financial product we launch.
We are now looking for a Backend Engineer (Golang) to build that protection. You will design and ship real-time detection and automated enforcement for our financial products across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo. The work is high-throughput, low-latency, and unusually consequential: a rule you ship on Monday can stop a serious loss by Friday. It is also close to greenfield, so you will be setting the patterns every future financial product inherits on day one.
This role will be based in London, UK as one of the founding engineering roles in our London hub, working closely with our teams in Helsinki and Berlin.
What you'll do:

Build and maintain high-throughput, low-latency backend services in Go that score financial events in real time, including payout enrollments, bank account links, credit applications, and account-to-account transfers.
Design fraud detection and automated enforcement for our financial products end to end: from signal collection through to the decision that blocks a fraudulent payout.
Build on and extend our shared fraud decisioning platform, so signals, rules, and models work across all three of our brands instead of being rebuilt three times.
Partner closely with risk analysts, data scientists, and product managers to turn observed fraud patterns into shipped detection, and to know when a rule, a model, or a product change is the right answer.
Work across team boundaries with our account security, payments fraud, and financial product teams. We build on their signals rather than rebuild them, so clean interfaces matter.

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.
Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.
Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.
Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.
Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.
Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.
Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.
Nous recherchons plusieurs Account Executives pour notre segment des avocats individuels, un des marchés-clés de Doctrine. Tous les mois, des centaines d’avocats viennent naturellement sur Doctrine trouver l’information dont ils ont besoin pour conseiller et défendre leurs clients. Vous les aiderez à comprendre comment Doctrine permet de construire des stratégies juridiques plus solides.
 
C'est l’occasion de contribuer à la croissance de Doctrine sur un segment très dynamique, et de changer en profondeur l’utilisation de l’information juridique par les professionnels du droit au quotidien.Responsabilités
Vous gérez le cycle de vente de A à Z sur un parc prospect qui vous a été confié.
Vous gérez 70% d'outbound et 30% d'inbound, et optimisez la vélocité commerciale en équilibrant vitesse d’exécution et taux de transformation
Vous travaillerez main dans la main avec les équipe Ops et Marketing pour accélérer la croissance sur ce segment
Dans une démarche d'acquisition pure, vous prospectez l'ensemble de votre parc, qualifiez le besoin des comptes, démontrez la valeur de l’outil au travers de démonstrations, construisez des offre financières adaptées, négociez & signez un maximum de deals.
Vous vous coordonnez avec les membres de l'équipe étendue de Doctrine (BDR et CSM mais aussi Marketing, Sales Ops et Product) pour générer des opportunités business.
Profil recherché
Vous êtes avant tout un.e entrepreneur.se dans l’âme. Vous avez envie de collaborer avec les différents départements de Doctrine pour trouver la clé de notre croissance sur ce segment de marché.
Vous avez une expérience de prospection sortante de quelques années, idéalement dans la vente de logiciels SaaS.
Vous aimez être récompensé.e et vous êtes motivé.e par une perspective de variable déplafonné.
Vous êtes organisé.e et méthodique, vous savez prioriser
Vous n’avez pas peur du téléphone et savez faire preuve de résilience et de conviction.
Vous écoutez activement, vous êtes emphatique, précis.e et direct.e.
Vous avez une forte culture du feedback et souhaitez progresser sans cesse.
Une formation/expérience juridique est un vrai plus.
La connaissance de Salesforce est un atout.
Ce qui t'attend si tu rejoins Doctrine 🤝


Contribuer à un projet ambitieux, avec un impact réel et positif sur la société : rendre le droit plus accessible et plus ouvert.
Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides.
Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien.
Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc.



Nos valeurs 🤝
Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses.

Challenge the status quo : nous défendons les idées audacieuses qui contribuent à l’évolution de tout un secteur.
Liberty and responsibility : nous encourageons l’autonomie, l’impact de chacun·e et l’ownership.
Knowledge is power : l'information est au cœur de la mission de Doctrine, et nous cherchons constamment à progresser.
Release early, release often and listen to your customers : nous croyons au pouvoir de l’itération et à l’importance d’écouter en permanence notre marché, nos client·e·s et leurs problématiques.

🏡 Une politique de télétravail flexible permettant - selon les équipes - jusqu’à trois jours de télétravail par semaine.
🌴 Une politique de congés flexibles
🌱 Des opportunités concrètes de mobilité interne
🏄‍♂️ Des évènements collectifs réguliers
📚 Un vrai accent sur la formation individuelle et collective, avec un budget annuel de 750€ pour toute formation en lien avec ton poste - et des formations en équipe ou pour toute l'entreprise
🏋️‍♀️ Un abonnement Gymlib pour les activités sportives et bien-être
🧘 Un accès gratuit à la plateforme d'accompagnement à la santé mentale Moka.care et un accompagnement individuel allant jusqu’à 6 séances par an
👩‍⚕️ Une assurance santé avec Alan

🍏 Un équipement de travail neuf chez Apple

 

Notre processus de recrutement 🚀

Un premier échange de 30 min avec l’un.e de nos Talent Acquisition Manager pour bien comprendre ton projet professionnel et te présenter ce qu'on construit chez Doctrine
Une rencontre d’1h avec ton/ta futur.e manager, pour détailler le poste et le scope de l’équipe, mais aussi répondre à toutes tes questions.
Un ou deux tests techniques pour évaluer concrètement tes compétences
Une venue dans nos bureaux pour : un déjeuner avec 3 personnes de différents départements chez Doctrine, pour te donner un aperçu de tes futur.e.s collègues ; un échange sur les valeurs de l’entreprise pour te partager notre vision, et une rencontre avec notre CEO, Guillaume.

title: Technical Lead Engineering
description_clean:
Our R&D team gathers ~100 engineers divided into ~15 product and technical squads. Each product squad includes developers, product managers and designers. They are paramount to 360Learning’s response to our increasingly demanding customers and are strategic players for the growth of the company. 
Today, we need someone to drive the Technical vision and coach the other developers in the Analytics Squad. We created the Tech Lead role to help developers with the technical aspects of their jobs, such as coding and planning, and coordinate the delivery timeline with Product Managers and Product Designers. As a Technical Lead you will: 


be the point of contact for all technical topics from the squad (you can then redirect to another member of the squad)


be  the coach for the other developers of the squad (do Performance reviews and Career Path assessments)


keep coding since management will take ~20% of your time


participate in monthly meetings altogether with CTO and Engineering Director to celebrate successes and discuss technical or organizational challenges


You will report directly to the VP Engineering & Engineering Director
Within 1 month you will:
Discover 360Learning, its platform, its teams and its culture
Become familiar with how our R&D way of working
Understand the team's processes
Within 3 months you will:
Support your product squad: each squad has clear goals for innovation (e.g. driving users to create more courses), while also maintaining and improving product features and codebase that fall under its scope
Follow and coach the software engineers of your squad
Start identifying our developers' key strengths and areas of improvement to help them grow
Solve proactively challenges the developers are facing
Lead Performance Reviews and Career Path assessments calibration 
Work with the CPTO and the Engineering Director on maintaining your squad’s engagement
Within 6 months you will:
Share your best practices within the team
Create your own courses on the 360Learning platform
Suggest and implement process improvements in the squad
Maintain a good team spirit, for instance by organizing team-building activities (sync or async)
Ensure your team is able to ship valuable features, while maintaining the timing and the quality
Work with the product manager to define the product vision and set the technical direction for that part of our platform
Join cross-team initiatives (e.g. organizing Hackathons)
Within 12 months you will:
Share process improvements with all the squads, and help them implement these changes
Push for technical innovations in the squad and outside
Identify the career next steps of your team members and define an action plan to reach them
The Skill Set:
You have either formally or informally served as a tech lead/mentor/coach for a team of software engineers working on a Saas platform for 2+ years.
You have led technical initiatives in an environment where performance, reliability, and accuracy are paramount and where “feature development” and roadmaps are measured in months and quarters.
You have significant full stack programming experience including experience with Agile methodologies, SaaS software architecture, and modern programming languages
You have a product-oriented mindset and care deeply about the customers and the customer experience.
Excellent leadership, communication, and collaboration skills

title: Post-doctorante ou Post-doctorant en Evaluation de la vulnérabilité d’un réseau d’accès Télécom de type PON (Passive Optical Network) vis-à-vis d’écoutes potentielles par DAS (Distributed Acoustic Sensor) - CDD de 12 mois
description_clean: Qui sommes-nous ?Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 5 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises.La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement.Nous recherchons notre futur(e) post-doctorant(e) en évaluation de la vulnérabilité d’un réseau d’accès Télécom de type PON (Passive Optical Network) vis-à-vis d’écoutes potentielles par DAS (Distributed Acoustic Sensor) pour rejoindre le département Communications et Electronique (COMELEC).Cette étude se situe dans le cadre du projet « Ecoute Acoustique Terrestre » (EAT) RAPID (Régime d’Appui Pour l’Innovation Duale), fruit d’un partenariat entre la société Febus Optics et Télécom Paris. La mesure de vibrations acoustiques distribuées par fibre optique (DAS, Distributed Acoustic Sensing) est une technologie récente, dont les applications ne cessent de se diversifier. On peut citer par exemple la détection d’intrusion en surveillance périmétrique, les mesures sismiques, le diagnostic de puits (pétrole, géothermie), etc. La bande passante de la mesure, de sub-Hertz à la centaine de kiloHertz, permet également d’envisager la captation de la bande audio, et donc de réaliser des mesures audios sur une fibre optique. Il est ainsi possible d’utiliser le réseau optique télécom d’un bâtiment pour réaliser des écoutes, en utilisant un système DAS modifié, intégrant des artéfacts matériels particuliers (enroulement, antennes, connecteurs) au voisinage de la zone d’écoute et un traitement du signal spécifique pour obtenir des performances suffisantes.Le cadre de ce Postdoc est d’évaluer la vulnérabilité d’un réseau télécom vis-à-vis d’écoutes potentielles par DAS. Le branchement sur un réseau optique Telecom local en fonctionnement nécessite de s’adapter à son architecture, notamment en termes de plan de longueur d’onde.L’audit des systèmes de télécommunication afin d’en évaluer la vulnérabilité constitue un enjeu majeur du réseau télécom. Un exemple de configuration d’un réseau d’accès est décrit dans la figure ci-après. Depuis le réseau Backbone, à partir du ‘Central Office’, les signaux télécoms sont acheminés chez les abonnés via le PON (Passive Optical Network). À l’intérieur des bâtiments, un réseau FTTX (Fiber To The X=H home, X=R room, X=O office, etc) ou un réseau local LAN (Local Area Network) optique servent respectivement à acheminer le signal optique jusqu’au terminal final ou à communiquer entre deux terminaux locaux via une liaison optique. Le PON comprend une fibre nourricière (Feeder Fiber) puis, au moins, un coupleur 1×N. Le codage de l’information est alors un mélange de multiplexage en longueur d’onde grossier (C-WDM) et de multiplexage temporel (TDM). Chaque voie de sortie du coupleur 1×N est envoyée vers des groupes de 1 à n abonnés à travers, au moins, un filtre qui sélectionne la longueur d’onde qui leur est allouée. Le signal après ce filtre est alors monochromatique et codé TDM. Le dernier coupleur 1×n répartie le signal chez les n abonnés. Ce PON comprend donc, entre autres, des coupleurs passifs qui divisent les signaux vers différents abonnés mais aussi des connecteurs, soudures, etc.L’objectif de ce Postdoc est de faire un état des lieux des différents types de réseau mis en place et d’en évaluer les conséquences sur la capacité de mesures DAS :·         Description des différents types de réseaux locaux existants,·         Etats des lieux des différents types de transmission : CWDM, TDM, …·         Quels sont les différents points d’accès pour une mesure DAS ?·         Comment discriminer les différentes fibres interrogées après un coupleur ? Influence des points réflecteurs,·         Etude des différentes marges de puissance pour une mesure DAS,·         Potentielle présence de nœuds d’insertion et limite de la transparence optique,·         Sensibilité des mesures DAS en fonction des différents types de fibre et de leur environnement,·         Influence du réflecteur final sur la capacité d’écoute.Le caractère innovant sera la définition des conditions du réseau et des configurations et des performances DAS permettant un audit cyber sur des infrastructures déjà déployées.Au-delà d’une synthèse des configurations que l’on peut trouver sur le terrain, il s’agira de mener des tests, soit sur un réseau réel auxquels un accès nous sera donné, soit sur un réseau modèle implémenté pour l’étude. Ces travaux permettront d’identifier le type de modules d’interfaçage nécessaires, et de les spécifier, puis de les concevoir et de les fabriquer.Vos principales missions seront :Assurer des missions de recherche dans le domaine des capteurs à fibre optique distribuésAssurer des missions d’encadrement et de tutoratParticiper à la notoriété de l’Ecole, de l’Institut Mines-Télécom et de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris  Vous êtes titulaire d’un doctorat en génie électrique, en communications optiques, en photonique, en capteurs optiques ou dans un domaine connexe. Vous disposez d’une solide expertise théorique et pratique en photonique et en traitement du signal numérique, ainsi que de bonnes compétences en programmation. Une connaissance des algorithmes de traitement du signal appliqués aux systèmes de communication ou aux capteurs à fibre optique, notamment dans le cadre de la détection cohérente, constitue un atout. Vous maîtrisez l’anglais, et la pratique du français est souhaitée.Vous manifestez un intérêt marqué pour la recherche appliquée et êtes capable d’évoluer dans un environnement multiculturel. Vous êtes à l’aise pour encadrer des stagiaires ou des étudiants dans le cadre de projets. Enfin, vous faites preuve d’un bon esprit d’équipe, de qualités relationnelles, rédactionnelles et pédagogiques, ainsi que d’une excellente capacité d’analyse et de synthèse.Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?Vous travaillerez dans un environnement en plein développement, agréable, verdoyant et accessible (notamment pour les personnes en situation de handicap) à seulement 20 km de Paris (RER B et C, proximité des grands axes routiers, navette mutualisée en partance de la Porte d'Orléans). We're looking for a Staff Data Scientist, Pricing to build the analytical and machine learning capability that pricing runs on, from demand modelling through to the systems that recommend price.

Develop machine learning models for demand forecasting and willingness-to-pay, and take them from exploration through to production with the monitoring and retraining that keeps them honest.


Move us from predictive to prescriptive by building the optimisation layer that turns forecasts and elasticities into recommended prices under margin, competitive and partner constraints.


Design and analyse pricing experiments with statistical rigour, and apply causal methods where clean randomisation isn't possible.


Define pricing within our data ecosystem, owning the governed definitions of price, cost and package economics that reporting, analysis and product surfaces all read from.

Set the analytical standard for pricing at Airalo, from what counts as evidence through to how a model or recommendation gets validated before it influences live pricing.

Experience with dynamic or algorithmic pricing systems in production.

Hands-on machine learning experience across the full lifecycle, from feature engineering and model selection through to deployment


Familiarity with optimisation and decision-science methods that turn predictions into recommended actions, whether through constrained optimisation, bandits, or reinforcement learning approaches.

Excellent communication skills, including the ability to make a methodological argument to people who won't check your standard errors.

title: wo-stage economie: Nowcasting Model voor BBP
description_clean: wo-praktijkstage, start in overlegKrijg jij energie van het bouwen van slimme datamodellen die economische groei voorspellen nog voordat alle cijfers binnen zijn? Duik jij graag in data, ontdek je nieuwe databronnen en wil je met jouw analyses échte impact maken op officiële bbp-ramingen? Dan is deze stage in nowcasting en econometrie precies wat je zoekt.Dit is jouw uitdagingBij het ramen van de kwartaalcijfers van het bbp (economische groei) gebruiken we voor een aantal bedrijfstakken momenteel een relatief eenvoudige methode: de ontwikkeling van het aantal banen dient als benadering voor de economische activiteit. Dit gebeurt omdat directe en tijdige broninformatie ontbreekt. Een belangrijk gevolg hiervan is dat we de eerste ramingen later vaak moeten bijstellen wanneer er meer volledige data beschikbaar komt bij de definitieve raming (ongeveer anderhalf jaar later).Het is aan jou om deze methodiek te verbeteren.Je gaat een geavanceerder model ontwikkelen waarmee we de economische activiteit van deze bedrijfstakken kort na afloop van de verslagperiode nauwkeuriger kunnen inschatten. Dit wordt ook wel “nowcasting” genoemd. Het doel is om dichter bij de uiteindelijke realisatie te zitten en daarmee het aantal en de omvang van latere bijstellingen te verkleinen.Een belangrijk onderdeel van jouw opdracht is om te onderzoeken welke databronnen tijdig beschikbaar zijn en we kunnen gebruiken als input voor dit model. Vervolgens ga je met behulp van historische data eerdere verslagperiodes simuleren. Zo kun je analyseren of jouw voorgestelde methode daadwerkelijk beter presteert dan de huidige aanpak, bijvoorbeeld door te kijken naar kleinere bijstellingen.Tot slot ontwikkel je een werkende productiestraat in R, zodat de nieuwe methode praktisch toepasbaar wordt binnen het ramingproces.Dit is jouw stageplek,bij CBS Den Haag We verwelkomen je binnen de sector Nationale Rekeningen, bij het team Aanbod- en gebruiktabellen, dat bestaat uit ruim 25 mensen. Het team maakt de kwartaal- en jaarramingen van het bruto binnenlands product (bbp), en de economische groei. We zijn gedreven onderzoekers en producenten van cruciale informatie, waaronder de economische groei, en continu op zoek naar verbeteringen.De nationale rekeningen vormen de officiële overzichtsstatistiek van de nationale economie. Het nationaal inkomen, de economische groei, het overheidstekort en het beschikbaar inkomen van huishoudens zijn enkele belangrijke macro-economische indicatoren die aan de hand van de nationale rekeningen worden vastgesteld.Binnen ons team heerst een open, betrokken en collegiale sfeer. Twee ervaren teamleden zullen je begeleiden bij deze stageopdracht.Dit breng jij meeJe volgt een economische wo-opleiding met een duidelijke kwantitatieve component.Je hebt kennis van – en bij voorkeur al enige ervaring met – softwareontwikkeling en programmeren in R.Je werkt nauwkeurig en gestructureerd, zowel met data als met code en documentatie.Je bent analytisch sterk en weet complexe vraagstukken te doorgronden en data kritisch te interpreteren.Je denkt proactief mee over het verbeteren van bestaande methoden en staat open voor het verkennen van nieuwe ideeën en technieken.Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je eigen werk: je plant, organiseert en bewaakt je voortgang gedurende de stage.Omdat tijdens de stage alle communicatie – zowel mondeling als schriftelijk – in het Nederlands plaatsvindt, is een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal noodzakelijk.Dit kun je van ons verwachtenEen fijne leeromgeving waarin je:Jouw programmeer- en analysevaardigheden inzet in een praktijkgerichte omgeving;Jouw vakkennis vergroot door samen te werken met ervaren collega's;Jouw kennis over econometrische en statistische modellen o.b.v. economische indicatoren in de praktijk gaat toepassen;Waardevolle werkervaring opdoet voor een toekomstige carrière in data analyse of onderzoek.Voor jouw inzet ontvang je een stagevergoeding van € 800,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week).Samen met je stagebegeleider stem je af hoe je hybride kunt werken, met flexibele werktijden en de optie om deels vanuit huis aan jouw stageopdracht te werken.Dit zijn onze voorwaardenHet betreft een stageopdracht en geen werkervaringsplek. title: Senior Fraud & Risk Analyst (f/m/x)
description_clean:
Your Mission
This is a company built for growth.  
When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone. We move fast, cut the noise, and focus on what actually matters, because in our industry, speed wins.  
With 50M+ platform downloads, we’re rapidly scaling one of the most exciting innovations in mobile gaming: a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps players discover, and engage with games they enjoy - creating lasting value for both players and gaming studios.  
As a Senior Fraud Analyst, you'll join our Fraud Analytics team as a close partner to our Fraud Analytics Team Lead - someone who can operate independently, mentor other team members, and help shape the fraud and risk agenda as the team and company scale.  
You'll work cross-functionally with different teams, dig into fraud patterns across our platform, and build the processes we don't have yet. It's a highly visible, high-ownership role in a fast-growing company.  
What You'll Own:

Strategic partnership: Partner directly with the Fraud Analytics Team Lead on strategy, ideation, and day-to-day problem solving - acting as a sounding board, ready to step in and keep things moving when needed.
Reporting uplift: Drive the evolution of fraud and risk reporting, turning raw data into sharp, decision-ready insights.
Fraud trend analysis: Hunt down patterns across our user base, shape the detection logic and rules that keep us ahead of bad actors, monitor how those rules perform, and optimise them over time.
Process ownership: Own the design of fraud and risk processes end-to-end, spotting gaps and building what doesn't exist yet.
Experimentation: Test, learn, and iterate - running A/B tests to continuously sharpen our fraud prevention strategies.
Strategic thinking: Think beyond the day-to-day, helping define where fraud and risk management goes next as the team scales.
Mentorship & collaboration: Mentor teammates and partner cross-functionally with Tech, Data, Product, Support, and Finance - becoming a go-to person others rely on.

What You Bring

Fraud & risk experience: 5+ years in fraud, risk management, or a closely related financial risk function; direct fraud experience is a strong plus, ideally in gaming or another B2C/app-based industry.
Data & AI fluency: Comfort working with data - SQL, databases, and hands-on experience using AI tools for analysis and prompting.
Analytical mindset: Strong analytical skills and genuine comfort with numbers, paired with the ability to turn analysis into clear, actionable reporting.
Strategic contribution: Experience contributing to or developing risk/fraud strategy, not just executing existing processes — including running A/B tests to validate ideas.
Collaboration & mentorship: Experience mentoring or supporting colleagues, and working cross-functionally across different stakeholder perspectives.
Education: A relevant Bachelor's or Master's degree (Business, Finance, Accounting, Data/Mathematics, Engineering, or similar).
Language: Fluent English, written and spoken.

Nice to have:

Background in policy design or risk governance frameworks.
Relevant certifications such as CFE, CFCS, CAMS, CRISC, CFA, and/or FRM.
Working knowledge of relevant regulatory frameworks - e.g. GDPR, PSD2/SCA, AML/KYC principles, and PCI-DSS basics where payment data is processed.

How We Win

Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.
Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.
See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.
Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.
Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
Product Manager
description_clean: About NousNous is a household AI agent. It takes over the bills and admin people don't have time for and acts for them: switching energy, buying insurance, cancelling forgotten subscriptions, managing the family calendar. Nearly 250,000 UK households have signed up, and another joins every minute.We think the real value of AI isn't writing amazing cover letters, it's doing useful things in the real world for real people. That's the hard part, and a brilliant product is only half of it. An energy switch takes weeks, so our agents run on long-running workflows, not a single chat turn. Cancelling a subscription means a browser agent handling the code Apple sends to your phone. Buying insurance meant getting our regulatory principal comfortable with an agent doing it end to end (a UK first), which comes down to knowing exactly when the LLM should hand over to rules because a mistake would cost someone real money.We're about 30 people running one agent across energy, broadband, mobile, insurance, mortgages and subscriptions (with more being added), each with its own suppliers, rules and ways of going wrong. With far more problems than people, a person or small team owns each one end to end, from spotting it in the data or a customer conversation to shipping the fix. And because the agent acts, you find out quickly whether the fix worked.Everyone builds here: a product engineer launched our subscription cancellation product within a couple of months of joining, and a PM rebuilt our WhatsApp agent.And it's working. We're growing more than 20x year on year, with a market-leading NPS above +80, and we manage well over half a billion pounds of household spending. We've raised more than $30M from Heartcore, Mosaic and a who's who of entrepreneurs who founded Monzo, GoCardless, lastminute.com and Onfido. But the real draw is the team - ask anyone here why they joined and you'll get some version of "to do great work with really smart people".The goal is household life that's simpler, cheaper and fairer, and most of that is still to build. How we build (worth reading before the role)How products get built is changing fast. With AI tooling, a PM can prototype, dig into production data and commit production code to get a change live all in an afternoon. An engineer can own a product area end to end and decide what to build next.We're leaning into that. Our PMs lean into code and our engineers run products: one of our engineers owns the car insurance targets. We care about whatever gets the job done most effectively, regardless of once upon a time whose job it was meant to be.We're moving fast and adapting as we go, and we don't have all the answers yet. What should a squad look like when everyone can build? Where does process still help, and where does it just slow you down? What's a PM for when an engineer can run the experiment themselves? We're working it out, and we want someone who is excited to be part of helping figure it out. About the roleSo where does a PM fit? A lot of our work still suits squads: clear targets, a few service lines and a team of engineers. Those squads need product managers to run them. All our roles in product overlap, but this one is centred on product management. If you’d rather spend all your time building, have a look at our Product Builder role.You’ll take a squad responsible for a key section of our product and service lines and grow them: expand what they cover, understand the levers that drive their performance (automation, new suppliers, what we recommend to members) and increase their commercial value.Being a Product Manager at Nous is one of the hardest roles we have. The product is complex and we move fast, so you need to be able to hold a lot of context. You'll switch between very different things all day: thinking about OKRs and the plan for the next couple of weeks one moment, getting a PR into production the next, while helping unblock an engineer.That's also what makes it exciting.You bring order to fast-moving work, get some sequencing in place so people aren’t each figuring it out on their own, evaluate what’s being shipped, own the reporting and keep the squad’s energy up. You won’t hesitate to make changes yourself, but you won’t be just another builder in the squad either: when you’re heads-down building, you can’t unblock anyone or bring the team together.Growing a service line here means working across the boundary between product and commercial, so we’re particularly interested in PMs who’ve had real exposure to the commercial side of a business.Our agent acts in the real world a lot, so saving someone money takes more than great product execution. We also need access to the best tariffs and suppliers, and we have to understand the regulation we operate in. And because Nous is an agent, your nice neat Amplitude funnels don't work: every user's journey can be totally different. So we're after PMs who are excited by everything it takes to make an agentic product work for real households, including the bits that wouldn't traditionally count as "product".Worth being upfront: we can't tell you yet which service lines you'd own. It depends on the Venn diagram of your particular skill set and the problems we need to solve at the point you join. What matters mostWe need all of these at once:Sharp. You pick things up quickly and enjoy hard problems. Given a messy one, you can lay out what you know and what you'd check first, then change your mind as new data turns up.Adaptable. We’re working a lot of this out as we go, so the role and the squad will change, probably more than once. You enjoy that. You pick up whatever’s needed, PM work or not, and you work in the open: sharing rough thinking early and changing course when someone has a better idea.Delivery. You bring order to a fast-moving squad: clear priorities, sensible sequencing, people unblocked quickly, and an honest look at whether what shipped actually worked.Product craft. You find the real problem behind a request and make the trade-offs explicit. You care about the details of what our users actually see.Commercial and analytical. You know what your area made last month, what moved it and what you'd do next, and you answer most of your own questions with data. You think in conversion, margin and lifetime value as readily as in features.Energy. You've probably worked at a startup. You move fast, you're happy doing the unglamorous work yourself, and you'd rather ship this week's version than polish next quarter's.And everyone builds here, PMs included. You'll use AI tooling (Claude Code or whatever gets it done) to prototype, dig into data and ship changes yourself. You don't need to be an engineer, but you shouldn't be scared of code. What you'll actually doGrow your service lines. Understand what really drives their performance, be able to measure it, and lead the squad to deliver it.Set the squad's OKRs and roadmap, get the sequencing in place, and drive fast, efficient execution.Evaluate what’s being shipped, and own the reporting: make sure the reports and the data behind them make sense.Work across product and commercial: the suppliers and tariffs we can offer, the regulation we work within, and what that means for what gets built.Run experiments, and unblock yourself on the analysis without always needing an analyst.Get close to members and ops. Read the conversations, sit with the people handling the edge cases, and fix the parts of the journey where people drop out or get stuck. About youYou'll likely thrive here if:You've been a PM for a few years, ideally at a startup, and you've owned something with a number attached: revenue, conversion, retention.You've worked on the commercial side as well as the product side: a P&L, a supplier or partner relationship, pricing, or a whole service line.You're comfortable enough with data and code to unblock yourself.Nice-to-haves:You were a software engineer before you moved into product.You've worked on a transactional or regulated product: insurance, fintech, energy, marketplaces.You've built and shipped your own thing: a startup, a side project, an internal tool that took off.This probably isn't for you if your PM experience is mostly roadmaps and stakeholder management at a big company, with no number you owned. How we workWe keep the middle thin, on purpose. There's barely any middle management, which means fewer bottlenecks and room for exceptional people to have real impact without first being promoted into managing others. It's a real bet, not a free lunch. Instead of a manager buffer, you get lots of context and colleagues who help because they're invested, not because an org chart says so. If you need a clear remit handed down before you can move, this probably won't suit you.Your first 90 days are built around getting you to real ownership safely: pairing when you want it, lots of context, and people who want you to ship. We celebrate the person who built the unglamorous version this week, not whoever thought of it first.We're office-first, near Farringdon. We do a lot of our best thinking together and being in the same room helps, though we're pragmatic about heads-down work when you need it. Remuneration and benefitsCompelling package including share options with life-changing upside. We've raised enough to pay real salaries, and we all share in the upside. As a Senior Product Manager, Cruise Liners & Port Operations, you will own both products end to end, from strategy and roadmap through to the first release and go-to-market. Working closely with the Lead Product Manager – Maritime & Logistics, you will build two early-stage products in parallel, leveraging Kpler’s network of more than 13,000 AIS receivers and over 10,000 mapped ports and berths.
For Cruise Liners, you will develop itinerary intelligence for tracked fleets, providing an independent view of actual sailed itineraries, fuel consumption and emissions. For Port Operations, you will build a product focused on port-level vessel activity monitoring, giving port authorities a reliable, live view of activity and performance.
This is an individual-contributor role for an experienced product professional with a background in maritime, cruise, travel, ports or an adjacent B2B data/SaaS environment. You will need to balance competing priorities across two products, establish trusted data methodologies, engage customers and bring both products to market through a pragmatic, build-and-iterate approach.

Own the product strategy and roadmap for Cruise Liners and Port Operations, prioritising customer needs and commercial opportunities while making trade-offs between the two products explicit.

This is a hands-on role: expect to read code, threat model new services, reproduce and triage vulnerabilities, dig through infrastructure configuration and build the automation that closes gaps. You'll also set direction and bring product and engineering with you, but that influence comes from technical credibility and not process: the engineers you work with will take you seriously because you've been in the same code they have.
The scope is broad: application security, infrastructure security, detection and response, and the assurance work that keeps our certifications standing. You won't be covering it alone. The security team is seven people and growing, with colleagues already owning compliance, governance and security operations, so this role can go deep on product and infrastructure and not be spread too thin across everything. Nobody arrives fluent in all of it: we're looking for real depth in several of these areas and the judgement to grow into the rest.
Key responsibilities include:


Product & Infrastructure Security Design - Design security features into the product itself and strengthen defence-in-depth across the platform. Threat model new services before they ship, and make the architectural calls that are expensive to reverse later.


Security Review & Risk Assessment - Review code, architecture and configuration yourself, and be the person developers and PMs bring problems to early rather than late. Deliver solutions that balance risk against business benefit, and escalate the calls that genuinely need senior arbitration.


Assurance & Testing - Run our assurance programme: internal code, architecture and configuration reviews, red team exercises, and the bug bounty. Own the relationship with third-party auditors, and measure the control KPIs that keep our certifications defensible.


Vulnerability Management - Own vulnerabilities from detection through to verified fix: reproduce them, score and triage them, design or validate the mitigation, and confirm it actually worked. Improve the KPIs that tell you whether the process is holding.


Detection Engineering - Build and improve our detection capability alongside the infrastructure and engineering teams: identify the signals worth collecting, write rules that catch real attacks without drowning us in noise, and build the response playbooks behind them.


Incident Response - Lead security investigations into the production environment end to end, from first signal to root cause, across incidents and fraud. Flag the repetitive work worth automating and the detections worth building, and hand those to the security operations team.


SDLC - Set the technical direction for how engineers at Pigment build securely: guidance, paved paths, and reviews that teach and not just gate. Contribute to company-wide awareness where it counts, but your primary audience is product, engineering and SRE.


 
Example projects that would fall under your responsibilities (actual examples of recently completed or currently on the roadmap):


Secure the design and development of our AI features, including the MCP Server and Modeler Agent: threat modelling, design reviews, working alongside the engineers building them, and security assessments. 


Work out where AI-assisted analysis actually belongs in our pipeline. AI-powered security reviews reason about a diff semantically rather than pattern-matching it, which is genuinely different from classic SAST - but it's not a drop-in replacement, and figuring out the split between AI review, traditional SAST and SCA is an open question we'd like you to answer with evidence rather than vendor claims.


Migrate GitHub to managed identities: provisioning through Okta, retiring personal accounts and long-lived PATs, and moving CI to short-lived OIDC credentials instead of stored keys.


Design agent identity for the MCP Server - delegated access tokens, token exchange, and making sure an agent acting for a user can never exceed what that user could do themselves.


Push least privilege further across production and CI/CD. Better than it was, not where we want it.
